jobs.title: AI & Software Engineering Intern - FinTech Systems
jobs.description: **Position Overview** Our specialized financial services consulting firm has been engaged by an established financial technology and brokerage group to identify a small number of high\-potential students for its AI Engineering Internship, joining the client’s internal AI transformation team. This is not a coffee\-and\-slides internship. Selected students will work directly alongside our client’s senior engineering and department leads, contributing to production software modules, data workflows, and system integrations that the business actually runs on. The work is real, it is reviewed closely, and it ships. The focus is practical engineering: connecting systems through APIs, structuring and cleaning data, and automating internal processes such as client onboarding and the client portal. The role suits students who want to see how a financial technology business operates from the inside and who learn fastest by building. AI is at the core of how this team builds. Interns are expected to work with AI coding assistants and LLM tools every day: to design and write code, explore unfamiliar systems, generate tests, and automate workflows. Hands\-on experience programming with AI is a requirement, not a nice\-to\-have. Our client is looking for curiosity and tenacity above credentials. Students who perform well will be given increasing ownership over individual modules and a clear path toward a longer\-term engagement with the firm. **Our Client** Our client is a financial technology group serving active and institutional traders, with an established product suite spanning execution, market data, and quantitative research infrastructure. As the firm expands its institutional business, it is investing in the internal systems behind it: onboarding, client\-facing portals, data pipelines, and the integrations that connect them. This search supports that build\-out. **Location \& Format** **Location:** New York, hybrid (3 days in office, Midtown, next building from Penn Station) **Format:** Part\-time or full\-time options available **Reports to:** Department leads **Key Responsibilities** * **AI\-assisted development** – Use AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, CodeX, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as a core part of daily work to design, write, test, and document code, and build LLM\-powered steps into internal workflows where they add value * **System integration** – Design, build, and maintain API connectors between internal and external databases and systems * **Module development \& automation** – Support the development and automation of core internal modules, including client onboarding and the client portal * **Data processing \& management** – Structure, clean, and analyze diverse datasets; set up reliable database connections and keep data logic consistent across systems * **Technical collaboration** – Work directly with lead engineers and department heads to translate business logic into working code and automated scripts * **Independent problem\-solving** – Read documentation, investigate unfamiliar systems, and resolve technical problems independently before escalating **Target Candidate ProfileFields of Study** * Master’s or upper\-level Bachelor’s students in Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Physics, Computational Finance, Financial Mathematics * Ideally with a minor or concentration in Data Science or Finance **Track Record Beyond Coursework** Preference will be given to students who have shown initiative outside the standard curriculum, for example: * Math, physics, or programming olympiads * Coding competitions and hackathons * Business case challenges * Active roles in technical, quantitative, or finance student clubs **Requirements** * **Analytical rigor** – Strong mathematical foundation, logical reasoning, and a structured approach to problem\-solving * **Software \& data fundamentals** – Practical programming experience with a solid grasp of software development principles, APIs, database architecture, and data structures * **Hands\-on AI programming experience (required)** – Demonstrated experience building software with AI coding assistants and LLM tools; be ready to walk through a concrete project and explain how you used AI to build it and how you verified its output * **Curiosity** – Real curiosity about how systems and financial businesses work, evident in projects you started on your own * **Tenacity** – The persistence to work through documentation and unfamiliar codebases and to finish difficult tasks without step\-by\-step guidance * **Coachability** – Openness to direct code review and the ability to apply feedback quickly * Clear written and spoken English **Strong Plus Qualifications** * Experience building with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar), prompt engineering, RAG, or agent frameworks * Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, or integration and automation platforms * Familiarity with relational databases and basic data modeling * Personal or academic projects available on GitHub or a portfolio * Interest in markets, trading, or financial technology **What This Role Is Not** To save everyone time: this is not a quantitative research or trading position. Our client is looking for strong data skills, sound logic, and solid software engineering fundamentals. Nor is it a role for someone who treats AI tools as optional: they are central to the day\-to\-day work. Equally, this is not a passive observation role. Students who prefer well\-defined tasks with close supervision at every step are unlikely to enjoy it; those who like to take a vague problem, read up, and come back with working code will. *This search is being conducted by a specialized financial services consulting firm on behalf of an established financial technology and brokerage group. All applications will be treated in strict confidence. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for initial screening before being presented to our client.* *Note: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States.* Pay: From $16\.00 per hour Expected hours: No more than 40\.0 per week Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10123

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ We are reimagining how people buy and navigate healthcare. More than 80% of Americans receive health insurance through an employer or purchase coverage through individual and Medicare exchanges. Yet the experience remains overpriced, opaque, and inefficient. We replace the traditional brokerage with an AI\-native platform built to streamline this process while helping people choose plans, find care, schedule appointments, call insurance, and fight bills. Our goal is not to build a better brokerage. It is to redefine how healthcare is bought and managed across America. **Why Join Us** =============== * **Scaling quickly:** We are growing quickly and looking for zero\-to\-one builders who want an outsized opportunity to learn and shape the company’s future. * **High impact:** Healthcare costs are rising at record rates, while the user journey has never been worse. Join us as we rebuild an industry. * **Best\-in\-class talent:** Work alongside teammates from leading tech companies including Uber, Faire, Airbnb, Rippling, Google, Forward, and Collective Health, as well as brokerage industry leaders including Newfront, WTW, Marsh, and Sequoia. Our team works together in person in San Francisco. * **Well funded:** Seed\-stage startup well funded by top VC's **About the Role** ================== Our product depends on bringing together data that has never previously lived in one system: insurance plans and networks, provider and pricing data, employer and member information, claims and medical records, and the activity generated across our own products and operations. We are looking for our first Data Engineer to build the foundation that makes this information reliable and usable across the company. This person will own the systems that ingest data from APIs, files, vendors, customer systems, public sources, and legacy portals; model it into durable representations; and make it available to our products, AI agents, operators, and business systems. This is a hands\-on role with broad ownership across the data stack. You will make early architectural decisions, build the first versions yourself, and determine where rigor matters immediately and where simple systems can evolve. You will also help define how we use AI in data engineering to acquire, interpret, reconcile, and operate data more effectively. The right candidate has strong data engineering judgment, enjoys building from zero, and is excited to work with messy healthcare data where accuracy matters. **What You’ll Do** ================== * **Build our data foundation:** Own the systems that move, transform, organize, and serve data across the company, including the data warehouse (e.g. Databricks), ingestion and export infrastructure, orchestration and scheduling (e.g. Airflow or Dagster), transformation and modeling tools (e.g. dbt), semantic layers, data catalogs, quality, and observability. * **Unify fragmented healthcare data:** Ingest and connect data from paid vendors, carriers, providers, government sources such as CMS, customer and benefits administration systems, public files, APIs, legacy portals, and our own applications. Build durable workflows for large files, changing schemas, incomplete records, and sources that were never designed to work together. * **Make the data trustworthy:** Design canonical models for plans, networks, providers, employers, members, claims, and other core concepts. Preserve historical state, lineage, provenance, and source\-specific nuance so our products, agents, operators, and customers can rely on the results. * **Put data into production:** Make curated data available wherever it creates value, including our backend, member and employer experiences, AI agents, brokerage workflows, CRM, reporting, and other operational tools. Build reliable systems for moving data both into and out of the warehouse. * **Use AI to improve data engineering:** Apply models and agents to acquire information from portals and older websites, interpret unfamiliar files, map changing schemas, reconcile conflicting sources, investigate quality issues, and automate work that has traditionally been manual. * **Set the roadmap and standards:** Work across product, engineering, brokerage, and operations to identify the highest\-leverage data capabilities, prioritize the roadmap, and decide where we need durable infrastructure now and where a simpler solution can evolve. **Who You Are** =============== * **AI\-native:** You think from first principles about how models and agents can change data engineering, from acquiring data in legacy systems to interpreting files, mapping schemas, and investigating failures. You know when to use AI, when deterministic systems are safer, and how to build the evaluations and review loops needed for trustworthy results. * **End\-to\-end data engineer:** You have built and operated production data systems across ingestion, warehousing, orchestration, modeling, quality, and serving. You are hands\-on in SQL and Python and comfortable choosing and owning the surrounding tools. * **Comfortable starting from zero:** You can turn broad goals into a clear sequence of work and take responsibility from initial design through reliable production operation. * **Comfortable with messy data:** You have worked with data from external organizations, not only clean application events. You understand temporal modeling, idempotency, schema evolution, lineage, provenance, and how to establish trust when sources are incomplete or contradictory. * **Practical architect:** You can make important technical decisions without overbuilding. You know which choices will be difficult to reverse, where correctness is essential from the beginning, and where a simple first version is appropriate. * **Operationally minded:** You think beyond dashboards and analytical queries. You are comfortable designing data systems that directly support applications, automated workflows, customer\-facing experiences, and business operations. * **Able to work across disciplines:** You enjoy working with engineers, operators, and industry experts to turn complicated real\-world concepts into clear models, interfaces, and systems.

jobs.title: Director of Technology Services CGESD 2026-27
jobs.description: **Columbia Gorge Education Service District** **Job Description** **Job Title:** Director of Technology Services **Assignment:** Technology Services **Reports To:** Superintendent **Evaluated By:** Superintendent **FLSA Status:** Exempt / Administrative **Wage:** $126,060\.00 \- $131,790\.00 Annually **JOB SUMMARY** The Director of Technology Services provides executive strategic, operational, and technical leadership for the Columbia Gorge Education Service District’s (CGESD) technology infrastructure, instructional technologies, cybersecurity, enterprise data, and regional service initiatives. Reporting directly to the Superintendent and serving as a member of the Executive Administrative Team, the Director leads the strategic use of technology to support the ESD’s mission of improving student outcomes with excellence, equity, and efficiency. The Director establishes a comprehensive, regional technology vision aligned with Local Service Plan priorities, component school districts, and contracted user needs across classrooms, offices, and schools. The position oversees department operations, directs capital replacement planning and budgeting, manages USAC E\-Rate programs, and supervises Technology Department personnel. Additionally, the Director leads enterprise data governance, Personally Identifiable Information (PII) protection, and regional technology coordination. After\-hours and emergency response duties are an expected component of exempt salaried responsibilities. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** *Essential duties of this position include the following. Employees in this position perform some or all of the following tasks. Other related duties may be assigned.* * Leads strategic and operational implementation for the Technology Department, establishing service expectations, departmental workflows, technical standards, and performance benchmarks that align with the CGESD mission, vision, and board strategic goals. * Drives the strategic application of information and instructional technology in offices, schools, and classrooms to enhance student learning and regional operational efficiency. * Supervises, evaluates, and leads Technology Department personnel (including engineers, cybersecurity analysts, database managers, and technical support staff); manages recruitment, workload assignments, professional development, and personnel matters. * Develops, manages, and monitors the Technology Department operational budget in collaboration with Fiscal Services, ensuring fiscal integrity, cost\-effective service delivery, and alignment with district priorities. * Establishes and maintains a comprehensive multi\-year technology replacement and capital improvement plan, evaluating total cost of ownership (TCO) and long\-term sustainability across hardware and software ecosystems. * Directs the district’s E\-Rate program, federal technology grants, and regional funding opportunities to maximize financial resources and cost\-sharing for CGESD and component school districts. * Develops, implements, and monitors a comprehensive enterprise information security and data risk governance plan to safeguard assets, networks, cloud computing, and Personally Identifiable Information (PII). * Ensures that all CGESD and regional district employees receive systematic, ongoing training related to cybersecurity, information security best practices, and data privacy with focused attention on PII protection. * Provides executive leadership and oversight for enterprise networking, virtualized hypervisors, telecommunications, cloud tenant environments (Azure, AWS, M365, Google Workspace), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Student Information Systems (SIS), and database applications. * Oversees enterprise backup strategies, immutable data repositories, and disaster recovery execution protocols, leading periodic continuity testing to ensure high operational resilience and business sustainability. * Provides executive advice to the Superintendent, Board of Directors, and administrative team regarding technology investments, emerging instructional technologies, information security, and technical risk management. * Facilitates regional technology governance, local service plan alignment, and collaborative committees with component school district superintendents, technology directors, and educational partners. * Negotiates systems acquisitions, software licenses, vendor contracts, and end\-user service agreements in accordance with district procurement guidelines and state regulations. * Acts as executive technical escalation lead for major network disruptions, critical cybersecurity incidents, system outages, or complex inter\-agency technical integration challenges. * Coordinates with district facility leaders regarding long\-range infrastructure design, low\-voltage installation standards, and building technology systems in existing and new facilities. * Maintains accurate department documentation, inventory records, egulations. **Strategic, Analytical, and Communication Skills** * Visionary Strategic Planning: Ability to align technology investments with educational outcomes, equity, and regional Local Service Plans. + Executive Communication: Demonstrated ability to explain complex technical and quantitative concepts clearly to school boards, superintendents, and non\-technical stakeholders. + Inter\-Agency Collaboration: Skill in building regional partnerships, negotiating multi\-district service agreements, and fostering cooperative technology models. **Licenses and Clearances** * Valid Oregon Driver’s License and evidence of insurability. + Criminal Justice Fingerprint Clearance. + Successful completion of ESD background screening. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit, stand, walk, and use hands for fine manipulation, handle or feel, and reach with hands and arms using computer displays and keyboards. The employee is occasionally required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or climb stairs. Without significant risk of injury, the employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10–25 pounds and occasionally lift/move up to 50 pounds. **Physical Requirements Rating Scale:** *N \= Never (Not Present) \| O \= Occasionally (Up to 1/3 of time) \| F \= Frequently (1/3 to 2/3 of time) \| C \= Constantly (2/3\+ of time)* Stand / Walk **F** Squat / Stoop **O** Sit **C** Climb Stairs **O** Drive **O** Lifting 10 lbs **F** Single Grasping **F** Lifting 25 lbs **O** Fine Manipulation **F** Lifting 50 lbs **O** Computer / Display Use **C** Lifting 75\+ lbs **N** **WORK ENVIRONMENT** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The work is performed primarily in standard office and education service district facilities, with frequent travel required among CGESD buildings, component school districts, regional partner sites, and state training venues. The noise level in the work environment is typically low to moderate. Irregular working hours and evening/weekend duties are common, particularly during significant network outages, critical cybersecurity incidents, or major system cutovers. **OTHER** **Mandatory Child Abuse Reporting** As a mandatory reporter under Oregon law (ORS 419b.010\), you are required to immediately report to Law Enforcement and/or the Department of Human Services any instances of suspected child abuse. See ESD Board Policy for specific reporting protocols. *Note: This is not necessarily an exhaustive or all\-inclusive list of responsibilities, skills, duties, requirements, efforts, functions, or working conditions associated with the job. This job description is not a contract of employment or a promise or guarantee of any specific terms or conditions of employment. The ESD may add to, modify, or delete any aspect of this job (or the position itself) at any time as it deems advisable, pursuant to Board Policy.* Prepared By: KM Prepared Date: September 22, 2026 Reviewed By: DP Review Date: September 22, 2026 Approved By: Superintendent \& Board Adopted Date: **AGREEMENT** I have read and received a copy of this job description. I understand the expectations required for this position and that a copy of this job description will become part of my personnel file. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ Employee Signature Date

jobs.title: Field Service Technician II
jobs.description: The Field Service Technician II independently performs standard maintenance, testing, and troubleshooting activities on electrical power distribution and critical power systems. This role assumes ownership of assigned scopes, supports commissioning and corrective work, leads portions of job execution, and mentors apprentices and less experienced technicians. The technician is a fully qualified field resource capable of delivering consistent customer support without day\-to\-day supervision. **Key Responsibilities** **Maintenance \& Testing** * Independently perform preventive maintenance and testing on LV and MV switchgear, breakers, ATS, RPPs, and PDUs. * Execute insulation resistance, continuity, contact resistance, and basic functional testing with minimal supervision. * Perform breaker removal, inspection, and reinstallation under established procedures. * Support generator maintenance, load bank testing, and operational checks. **Transformers — Maintenance \& Field Testing** * Independently perform preventive maintenance and field testing on dry\-type, cast\-coil, pad\-mount, unit\-substation and liquid\-filled transformers up to medium voltage. * Perform and interpret insulation resistance, transformer turns ratio (TTR), winding resistance, and excitation current tests. * Perform oil sampling for dissolved gas analysis (DGA), moisture, and dielectric strength; interpret routine lab results and flag exceptions for engineering review. * Perform de\-energized tap changes and verify no\-load tap changer operation. * Inspect and service load tap changer (LTC) mechanisms and controls under established procedures. * Verify transformer grounding and perform ground resistance testing. * Verify cooling system operation (fans, oil pumps, RTDs and temperature control circuits) and alarm and trip signaling. * Support oil processing activities including filtration, dress and fill, and regasketing. * Troubleshoot common transformer issues including overheating, oil leaks, gauge and alarm faults, and cooling system failures. **Troubleshooting \& Commissioning Support** * Read and interpret one\-line diagrams, schematics, and wiring diagrams to support troubleshooting. * Troubleshoot common electrical, mechanical, and control issues; escalate complex faults to the Field Service Engineer or Sr. Field Service Engineer. * Support commissioning activities including pre\-energization checks, point\-to\-point verification, and functional testing. * Assist with control wiring checks, interlock verification, and basic communication diagnostics. * Assist with protection relay testing and secondary injection under the direction of a Field Service Engineer or Sr. Field Service Engineer. * Support verification of relay settings and functional checks of protection and control circuits. **Safety \& Compliance** * Comply with all safety requirements including LOTO, arc\-flash, energized work restrictions, job hazard analysis, and permits. * Participate in and contribute to on\-site safety briefings and follow safe work practices at all times. * Ensure work complies with applicable codes and standards (NFPA 70E, OSHA) and customer site\-specific requirements. **Mentorship \& Job Leadership** * Lead portions of job execution and oversee apprentices and Level 2 technicians on assigned tasks. * Share best practices and provide on\-the\-job training to less experienced team members. **Customer \& Documentation** * Communicate progress and findings clearly to lead technicians, project managers, and customers as needed. * Document service activities, complete test records, and maintain accurate punch lists and field reports. * Coordinate with project managers and supply chain on parts and material needs. **Qualifications** **Required** * High school diploma or GED required; technical school, military electrical training, or Associate's degree a plus. * 5–8 years of relevant field service experience with LV/MV switchgear, breakers, ATS, generators, or related electrical equipment. * Working knowledge of electrical safety practices including LOTO and arc\-flash risk controls. * Proven ability to read and interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, and one\-line diagrams. * Hands\-on experience performing transformer field testing (insulation resistance, TTR, winding resistance) and oil sampling. * Ability to write clear field reports and maintain accurate test documentation. * Valid driver's license with an acceptable motor vehicle record, maintained throughout employment; ability to travel as required, sometimes on short notice. * Must be at least 21 years of age to be assigned and operate a company\-provided service vehicle. * Must be able and willing to obtain Department of Transportation (DOT) non\-CDL qualification, including a current DOT medical card where required for towing test trailers or oil\-processing equipment, and comply with applicable DOT regulatory requirements. **Preferred** * OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification. * Completion of  d relay configuration software. * Exposure to control platforms (SEL, ComAp, Woodward) or PLCs. * Hands\-on use of relay test sets (e.g., Omicron, Doble) in a supporting role. * Experience with load tap changer inspection and oil processing (filtration, dress and fill, regasketing). * Working knowledge of IEEE C57 series transformer testing practices. **Core Competencies \& Behaviors** *All Forgent Power team members are expected to demonstrate safety, quality, continuous improvement, collaboration, accountability, and customer focus. In addition, this role requires:* * Solid understanding of LV/MV electrical distribution systems, grounding, and protection concepts. * Proficiency with electrical test equipment and torque tools. * Ability to troubleshoot common electrical and mechanical issues independently. * Strong safety compliance and documentation practices. * Clear communication with crew, customers, and leadership. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and mobile/field reporting tools. **Tools \& Technology** * Multimeters, clamp meters, insulation resistance testers, contact resistance meters, and continuity testers. * Insulation resistance testers (e.g., Megger) and contact resistance meters. * Breaker test sets and relay test equipment (e.g., Omicron, Doble) in a supporting role. * Transformer test sets — turns ratio (TTR), winding resistance, and excitation current (e.g., Megger, Doble). * Oil sampling and handling equipment; ground resistance testers. * Torque tools, mechanical gauges, and standard hand and power tools. * Mobile field service applications and document control/reporting systems. **Working Conditions \& Travel** * Primarily field\-based at customer facilities including industrial plants, utilities, data centers, commercial facilities, and substations. * Travel typically 50–80% depending on region and workload; may include nights, weekends, and emergency call\-outs on short notice. * Participation in the regional on\-call rotation is required. On\-call periods include nights, weekends, and holidays, and require the ability to respond to emergency call\-outs. * Project assignments may be long\-duration, typically ranging from several weeks to 12\+ months depending on scope and schedule. Assignments outside the home region are typically worked on a field rotation of three consecutive weeks on site followed by one week in the home office. * Work may be performed in confined spaces, on elevated platforms, in hot/cold environments, and around rotating machinery and energized equipment in accordance with safety rules. * Must be able to wear required PPE including arc\-rated clothing, hard hat, gloves, safety glasses, hearing protection, and fall protection as needed. **Physical Requirements** * Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs (23 kg) and move test equipment and tools. * Ability to stand, kneel, bend, climb ladders and stairs, and work at heights for extended periods. * Ability to differentiate conductor colors and indicator states and to read instruments and displays. * Ability to handle transformer test leads, oil hoses, and oil\-handling equipment, including lifting up to 75 lbs (34 kg) with assistance. **Disclaimer** The statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required. Forgent Power reserves the right to modify, interpret, or apply this job description as needed. Employment may be contingent upon successfully passing applicable screenings (e.g., background check, drug/alcohol testing) and meeting site\-specific customer requirements. **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** Forgent Power is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected class. \#LI\-EC1

jobs.title: IT Analyst
jobs.description: Job Summary We're seeking an IT Analyst II to support our enterprise data platform, working across data engineering, cloud infrastructure, and business intelligence. This role assists in building and maintaining data pipelines, supporting Data Science initiatives, and delivering reporting solutions, working closely with senior engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders. This is a strong opportunity for someone with solid data engineering fundamentals looking to grow within a structured enterprise environment. Duties * Support the design, development, and maintenance of ETL/ELT pipelines feeding enterprise data platforms * Assist in building and maintaining data models and datasets in **Databricks** to support analytics and Data Science workloads * Write and troubleshoot **SQL** queries for data extraction, transformation, and validation across relational databases * Develop and maintain data processing scripts and automation using **Python**, and contribute to application\-side work using **C\#** as needed * Support the development and upkeep of **Power BI** datasets, dataflows, and reports for business stakeholders * Assist Data Science teams with data preparation, feature engineering support, and productionizing models within existing pipelines * Work within **Azure** or **AWS** cloud environments to support data ingestion, storage, and processing workflows * Collaborate with business and technical teams to gather requirements and translate them into data pipeline or reporting tasks * Monitor pipeline performance, troubleshoot data quality issues, and escalate complex architecture or infrastructure problems to senior engineers Qualifications **Required:** * High school diploma or GED and a minimum of twelve (12\) years' IT experience, **OR** * Associate's degree and a minimum of eight (8\) years' IT experience, **OR** * Bachelor's degree in an IT\-related field and a minimum of five (5\) years' IT experience * Working experience with enterprise data platforms, data engineering practices, and cloud environments (Azure or AWS) * Hands\-on experience with **SQL** for querying and data validation * Programming experience in **Python**; jobs.description: Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. The team marries technology with creativity to build world\-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. * **Innovation:** We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Content Platforms \& Operations is responsible for the development and ongoing advancement of the technical and operational functions driving the worldwide distribution and monetization of Disney’s linear networks and theatrical content. This includes Disney’s media supply chain and storage, network and theatrical distribution operations, media localization, network transmission and origination, and more. The global team also plays a critical role as the primary collaboration point for Product \& Technology with Disney’s EMEA, APAC, and LATAM regional business teams. **Job Summary:** The Network Origination Manager will work rotational shifts to oversee a 24 hour / 7 day a week media network operations and ensure that all network feeds are aired as scheduled. This position upholds accountability for department performance, workforce planning, escalation management and cross\-functional alignment. The manager serves as a key decision maker for on\-air operations with oversight of the control of the Disney Media Networks and their underlying systems while maintaining a close partnership with internal teams such as Resources, Marketing, Programming, Media Operations and Traffic. This may include, but is not limited to, Disney Channel, Freeform, FX, National Geographic, ABC Television Network and owned ABC Television Stations. The Managers, in conjunction with On\-Air Support Operators, are the primary owners of decision making affecting the on\-air product. The Network Origination Managers balance the day\-to\-day protection of our high standard of quality while driving operational strategy, risk management and continuous improvement. The Manager should be familiar with all aspects of television operations. Along with On\-Air Support, the Managers will control communications between the network and affiliates and serve as a point of contact for all issues. A successful candidate in this role must be able to maintain a high\-level attention to detail across several streams and systems while being able to prioritize tasks and requests. Strong leadership qualities are required as the Manager, in conjunction with On\-Air Support, will be responsible for all decision\-making processes affecting the on\-air product and will interact with all levels of Management. Must be able to work well under pressure in a fast\-paced and deadline driven environment. and on\-time delivery of programming across all networks. * Flexibility to work all shifts composing a 24/7 day including swing shifts, overnights, weekends, holidays and special events is a must. * procedures aligned with legal and compliance requirements. * Lead forecast planning for complex operations regarding regionalization, workflow, distribution patterns, personnel and resource allocation * Drive continuous improvement through process optimization, workflow automation, and SOP development. * Partner cross\-functionally prioritizing relationships and professionalism in all interactions. * Oversee communication with network affiliates during live events, br ests and assure they are executed with high level of accuracy while maintaining consistency in decision making. * Remain current in their respective technical areas of responsibility for day\-to\-day support as well as to expand knowledge to provide workflow feedback during larger strategic initiatives. * Ensures resolution of day\-to\-day technical and operational problems as well as identify recurring issues that require workflow improvements. * Upholds professionalism using tact and diplomacy to exchange information and handle sensitive issues. * Lead the implementation of technological upgrades and projects furthering the vision of the Facility that drives scalability and operational efficiency. * Escalate technical and operational issues clearly to support, engineering and management through well written reports * Perform management administrative functions. * Assess and adjust the personnel and facility schedules to satisfy changing programming demands. * Lead, develop, and coach team members to drive performance management, talent development, and succession planning. * Evaluate the performance of direct reports, conduct performance assessments and administer annual reviews for assigned staff members. * Work constructively and respectfully with fellow team and department members to achieve a common goal while always upholding the values of The Walt Disney Company. **Basic Qualifications:** * A minimum of 8\-years experience in television broadcast * Advanced proficiency in live television operations * Expert knowledge of television network operations that may include traffic planning and timing calculation, playlist automation systems, signal flow, measurement tools and signal elements * Experience with playout automation systems. * Solid understanding video formats (SD, HD, UHD, HD\-HDR and video and audio standards (SMPTE). * Solid understanding audio formats such as mono, stereo, native 5\.1 \& 5\.1 up\-mix * Advanced understanding of video routing systems and analysis tools (waveform monitors, rasterizers and audio meters) * Solid knowledge and experience of live acquisition and remote workflows for live events and linear channels * Proactive problem\-solving and critical thinking skills * Use of good judgment when making decisions or addressing issues * Ability to make decision based on business priorities * Must be able to communicate calmly and effectively to the team while working in high pressure and stressful situations * Must be self\-motivated, organized and communicate clearly both verbally and in writing * Ability to understand and explain signal flow charts * Experience with VOD workflows and delivery formats * Understanding of Cloud\-based and on\-prem operations * Experience leading process improvement or operational transformation initiatives. * Advanced understanding of transmission signal flows inbound/outbound * High school diploma or equivalent **Preferred Qualifications:** * Familiarity with streaming media platforms (e.g., Netflix, Fire TV, Hulu, etc.) * Non\-linear editing experience or experience with EVS, Evertz Dreamcatcher jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer — E-commerce Platform
jobs.description: **Position Details** * **Employment:** Full\-time, permanent W\-2 employee. * **Location:** Fully remote within the United States; no office attendance or relocation required. * **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 40 working hours per week. Saturday and Sunday off. * **Working hours:** Flexible start and finish times, with availability from 11:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Central Time for collaboration. Lunch breaks are outside working hours. * **Base salary:** $175,000–$205,000 USD annually, before taxes, paid biweekly. * **Reports to:** Head of Engineering. * **Travel:** None required. **About ParcelNest** ParcelNest Technologies builds software that helps online retailers manage orders, inventory, and shipping through one platform. Our team focuses on making everyday operations simpler and more reliable for growing businesses. **About the Role** You will design and develop the backend services behind ParcelNest Hub, with a focus on order processing, inventory synchronization, and third\-party integrations. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with ownership of technical decisions, from initial design through deployment and ongoing improvement. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and Customer Support to turn real customer problems into reliable software. **What You’ll Do** * Build and maintain backend services and APIs for orders, inventory, and shipping workflows. * Develop integrations with e\-commerce platforms and shipping providers, including authentication, webhooks, and data synchronization. * Design background processing that handles retries, duplicate events, and third\-party service failures safely. * Improve database performance, data integrity, and the reliability of customer\-facing features. * Own projects from technical proposal and implementation through testing, rollout, and monitoring. * Investigate production issues during working hours and address their underlying causes. * Review code, document important decisions, and mentor teammates through pairing and constructive feedback. * Work with Product to balance customer needs, delivery timelines, and long\-term maintainability. **What You’ll Bring** * At least five years of professional backend software engineering experience. * Strong production experience with Python and a framework such as FastAPI or Django. * Strong SQL skills and experience designing, maintaining, and optimizing PostgreSQL databases. * Experience building APIs and integrating with external services. * Practical understanding of asynchronous processing, message queues, idempotency, and failure recovery. * Experience deploying and supporting applications in a cloud environment, preferably AWS. * Confidence writing automated tests, reviewing code, and using logs and metrics to diagnose problems. * Clear written and spoken English and the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote team. * Experience independently delivering a substantial feature or service from design to production. A computer science degree is welcome but not required. We value relevant experience and demonstrated engineering judgment. **Nice to Have** Experience with Shopify or WooCommerce integrations, fulfillment systems, multi\-tenant SaaS products, Redis, Terraform, or application observability. You do not need experience with every tool in our stack to apply. **Our Technology Stack** Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, Docker, Terraform, and GitHub Actions. **Compensation and Working Expectations** The base salary range is $175,000–$205,000\. Your offer will reflect relevant experience, system design skills, and the level of responsibility you can take on. The same range applies across eligible U.S. locations. This is a salaried position. The stated range is base pay and does not include the value of benefits. No variable bonus or equity award is included in this sample package. Compensation is reviewed annually. We plan work around a 40\-hour week. This position does not include an after\-hours on\-call rotation or scheduled evening or weekend work. **Benefits** * **Medical, dental, and vision:** Coverage begins on the first day of the month following hire. ParcelNest pays 90% of employee premiums and 50% of dependent premiums. * **401(k):** Eligible after 90 days, with a dollar\-for\-dollar employer match on the first 4% of eligible pay you contribute. Employer contributions vest immediately. * **Paid time off:** 20 vacation days accrued annually, plus 7 paid sick days and 10 paid company holidays. * **Parental leave:** 8 weeks of paid leave after 12 months of employment. * **Life and disability insurance:** Company\-paid basic life and short\-term disability coverage. * **Remote equipment:** Company\-provided laptop, monitor, and accessories, plus a one\-time $750 home\-office allowance. * **Internet support:** $75 monthly reimbursement toward home internet. * **Professional development:** Up to $1,500 annually for approved courses, certifications, books, or conferences. * **Paid onboarding:** A structured introduction to the product, architecture, and development process, with an assigned engineering buddy. **How We Work Together** We value thoughtful engineering, clear communication, and people who follow through. You will have room to work independently, with teammates available to discuss a design or help investigate a difficult problem. We document decisions, keep meetings focused, and give feedback respectfully. Asking for help is welcome. When something breaks, we focus on understanding the failure and improving the system. You can contribute fully whether you are outgoing or more reserved. Social activities are optional, and personal time is respected. **Your First 90 Days** * **First 30 days:** Learn the product and architecture, set up your development environment, and ship an initial improvement with support from your onboarding buddy. * **By 60 days:** Own a scoped backend feature or integration improvement through design, testing, and release. * **By 90 days:** Independently lead a project and contribute a practical improvement to reliability, performance, or the development process. Success is measured by reliable delivery, sound technical decisions, maintainable code, and effective collaboration. **Hiring Process** * A 30\-minute introductory conversation about your experience and expectations. * A 60\-minute practical coding and debugging session using a small sample service. * A 60\-minute system design discussion based on an e\-commerce workflow. * A 30\-minute conversation with the Head of Engineering about collaboration and ownership. No unpaid take\-home project is required. The target process takes two to three weeks, with time for your questions at every stage. **Eligibility and Application** Candidates must reside in the United States and be authorized to work there. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. An English\-language résumé is required. A LinkedIn profile, GitHub profile, or examples of relevant work are optional; a cover letter is not required. ParcelNest welcomes applicants from different backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Pay: $175,000\.00 \- $200,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

Reporting to the Sr. Director of Data Platform Transformations \& Operations, this role combines hands\-on engineering, solution design, and operational ownership to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable solutions. The engineer serves as a technical lead on major initiatives while remaining accountable for production support and operational excellence. Databricks Asset Bundles experience preferred. * Experience implementing data quality, validation, reconciliation, monitoring, metadata, lineage, governance, and security controls. * Strong technical leadership, solution design, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to independently lead complex work from design through production support and balance innovation with reliability, security, cost, and supportability. * Excellent collaboration, mentoring, documentation, and communication skills across technical and business teams. * Experience with Power BI, MicroStrategy, MDM, streaming architectures, infrastructure automation, or AI\-assisted development preferred. * Databricks Data Engineer certification at the Associate or Professional level preferred. Pay: $75\.00 \- $85\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Application Question(s): * Are you local to Austin, TX? * Are you comfortable to attend a face to face interview in Austin, TX? * Do you have strong Python Development experience along with SQL \& Databricks? * Are you comfortable to do a 90 minutes Hackerrank coding test? * Do you need sponsorship now or in future to work in the United States? jobs.description: The Sr. Field Service Engineer is the technical authority for complex field service, commissioning, and modernization work on low\- and medium\-voltage (and, where applicable, high\-voltage) power systems, including transformers and their protection and control. This role is responsible for ensuring the complete electrical system operates safely and as designed. It provides on\-site leadership, ensures safe work execution, interfaces directly with customers and project teams, and mentors Field Service Engineers and technicians while driving quality, schedule adherence, and continuous improvement. **Key Responsibilities** **Technical Authority \& Commissioning** * Lead commissioning and startup of complete electrical systems, including acceptance testing and verification of system performance. * Serve as the primary technical escalation point for advanced control, protection, and integration issues. * Plan and perform advanced diagnostics for equipment and protection/control issues, including intermittent faults and complex system interactions. * Perform protection relay commissioning and end\-to\-end verification; validate settings implementation against approved setting files and drawings. * Execute and direct acceptance, maintenance, and condition\-based testing (insulation resistance, contact resistance, timing/travel analysis, primary and secondary injection, relay logic verification, SCADA/RTU I/O checks). **Transformers — Diagnostics \& Condition Assessment** * Serve as the technical authority for transformer condition assessment and failure investigation. * Plan and perform advanced transformer diagnostics including sweep frequency response analysis (SFRA), dielectric frequency response (DFR), leakage reactance / short\-circuit impedance, partial discharge, and advanced insulation power factor testing. * Assess transformer condition by trending electrical test data, oil analysis (DGA, moisture, furan), and inspection findings against factory acceptance, commissioning, and historical baselines. * Diagnose complex transformer faults including overheating, abnormal gassing, bushing degradation, winding deformation, and load tap changer failures. * Lead transformer commissioning and acceptance testing for complete substations, including energization planning and switching sequences. * Direct transformer repair, overhaul, refurbishment and retrofit programs, including LTC overhaul and internal inspection. * Lead transformer failure investigations, report findings, and recommend repair, refurbishment, retrofit, or replacement. * Define transformer test plans, standards, and acceptance criteria for the region and support their inclusion in the Technical Qualification Program. * Interface with engineering and OEMs on transformer design limits, loading, and warranty or return material authorization (RMA) determinations. **Field \& Program Leadership** * Provide technical leadership during outages, turnarounds, and critical recovery events; communicate status, risks, and mitigation plans. * Direct testing activities and manage multiple work fronts; lead field crews, contractors, and junior engineers. * Approve commissioning documentation and close out actions with customer sign\-off. * Mentor and supervise Field Service Engineers and technicians at Levels 1 through 4; review work quality and coach troubleshooting approach. **Modernization \& System Integration** * Lead equipment\-level and system\-level modernization, retrofit, and integration projects. * Define execution strategies, risk mitigation plans, and field quality standards for complex programs. * Interpret retrofit drawings, relay and control information, and confirm field readiness for execution. * Direct corrective maintenance and repair activities, including breaker overhaul support, mechanism adjustments, alignment, lubrication, and component replacement. **Safety Leadership** * Lead on\-site safety briefings and enforce LOTO, arc\-flash, energized work restrictions, job hazard analysis, and permit requirements. * Lead root cause investigations, including high\-potential safety events, and drive corrective and preventive actions. **Standards, Process \& Customer Enablement** * Develop and standardize field procedures, commissioning standards, and best practices; support development of the Technical Qualification Program. * Coordinate with project managers, engineering, factory, and supply chain on parts identification, RMA/warranty, technical escalations, and root cause analysis. * Produce high\-quality field service reports, test records, punch lists, commissioning checklists, and nonconformance documentation. * Deliver customer training and knowledge transfer on system operation, basic maintenance, and safety considerations. * Identify modernization opportunities and communicate leads through the appropriate channels. **Qualifications** **Required** * 11\+ years of progressively responsible field experience with MV/HV switchgear, breakers, and continuous improvement, collaboration, accountability, and customer focus. In addition, this role requires:* * Expert\-level troubleshooting across switchgear mechanical, electrical, and protection/control domains. * Strong customer communication, including explaining findings, constraints, and corrective actions in clear, non\-technical language. * Working knowledge of common test instruments and safe test setups, including validation of calibration status. * Strong planning and prioritization; able to manage multiple work fronts during outages. * Ability to lead incident response and structured problem solving (5\-Why, fishbone, corrective and preventive actions). * Mentoring and coaching capability across all technician levels. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and mobile/field reporting tools. **Tools \& Technology** * Breaker test sets (timing/travel, micro\-ohmmeters), insulation resistance testers (e.g., Megger, Fluke), and hipot/VLF sets as applicable. * Relay test sets (e.g., Omicron, Doble) and primary and secondary injection systems. * Advanced transformer diagnostic equipment — SFRA, dielectric frequency response (DFR), leakage reactance, and partial discharge test sets. * Transformer test sets — TTR, winding resistance, excitation current, and insulation power factor / tan delta; oil processing plant oversight. * Digital multimeters, clamp meters, torque tools, mechanical gauges, and alignment tools. * Laptop\-based relay configuration and commissioning software; serial/Ethernet communications tools as applicable. * Document control/reporting systems and mobile field service applications. **Working Conditions \& Travel** * Primarily field\-based at customer facilities including industrial plants, utilities, data centers, commercial facilities, and substations. * Travel typically 50–80% depending on region and workload; may include nights, weekends, and emergency call\-outs on short notice. * Participation in the regional on\-call rotation is required. On\-call periods include nights, weekends, and holidays, and require the ability to respond to emergency call\-outs. * Project assignments may be long\-duration, typically ranging from several weeks to 12\+ months depending on scope and schedule. Assignments outside the home region are typically worked on a field rotation of three consecutive weeks on site followed by one week in the home office. * Work may be performed in confined spaces, on elevated platforms, in hot/cold environments, and around rotating machinery and energized equipment in accordance with safety rules. * Must be able to wear required PPE including arc\-rated clothing, hard hat, gloves, safety glasses, hearing protection, and fall protection as needed. **Physical Requirements** * Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs (23 kg) and move test equipment and tools. * Ability to stand, kneel, bend, climb ladders and stairs, and work at heights for extended periods. * Ability to differentiate conductor colors and indicator states and to read instruments and displays. * Ability to handle transformer test leads, oil hoses, and oil\-handling equipment, including lifting up to 75 lbs (34 kg) with assistance. **Disclaimer** The statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required. Forgent Power reserves the right to modify, interpret, or apply this job description as needed. Employment may be contingent upon successfully passing applicable screenings (e.g., background check, drug/alcohol testing) and meeting site\-specific customer requirements. **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** Forgent Power is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected class. \#LI\-EC1

jobs.title: Senior Mobile Engineer (React Native)
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Fanfix is a premier content platform dedicated to empowering creators and fostering meaningful connections with their fans. We provide a safe, brand\-friendly environment where creators can pursue their passions and monetize their work. With a global community of over 7 million fans, our platform enables engagement through features like direct messaging, memberships, tipping, and exclusive content. We’re committed to continuous innovation, building high\-performance web applications that elevate the creator and fan experience. **Role Overview** As a Senior Mobile Engineer at Fanfix, you’ll design and develop scalable mobile applications using React Native and Expo. Working closely with product, design, and backend teams, you’ll deliver fast, reliable, and visually polished native experiences on iOS and Android. With expertise in TypeScript, NativeWind, and modern mobile UI frameworks, you’ll ensure code quality, maintainability, and scalability while improving app performance and mentoring other engineers. This role is suited for a proactive engineer who thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment and is passionate about crafting smooth, high\-quality mobile experiences. You’ll report to the Lead Application Engineer. * Remote Position **Requirements** * React Native: Extensive experience building cross\-platform apps with React Native, including navigation, animations, and performance optimization. * Expo \& EAS: Proven experience with Expo SDK, EAS Build/Submit/Update, and OTA delivery workflows. * TypeScript: Strong command of TypeScript for clean, type\-safe, and maintainable codebases. * UI Frameworks: Familiarity with modern React Native UI frameworks such as NativeWind and shadcn/ui. * Mobile Performance: Deep understanding of app startup time, bundle optimization, memory management, and frame\-rate stability. * API Integration: Proven experience integrating GraphQL or REST APIs using tools such as React Query or Apollo Client. * Cross\-Platform Development: Knowledge of bridging native modules, managing platform\-specific configurations, and integrating third\-party SDKs. * Testing: Proficient with Jest and React Native Testing Library, plus experience with end\-to\-end frameworks such as Detox or Maestro. * Attention to Detail: Demonstrates precision in UI execution, state management, and platform\-specific behavior. * Initiative: Self\-driven, with the ability to take ownership of projects and deliver features from conception to completion. **Preferred Qualifications** * Design Systems: Experience contributing to or maintaining a shared cross\-platform design system (e.g., shadcn/ui \+ NativeWind \+ Radix primitives). * App Distribution: Familiarity with TestFlight, Google Play Console, and automated release pipelines. * CI/CD Experience: Understanding of GitHub Actions, EAS Build pipelines, and remote caching in monorepo environments. * Feature Flags \& Analytics: Experience integrating PostHog, LaunchDarkly, or similar tools for analytics and feature rollout. * Observability: Familiarity with Sentry, Expo Application Services, or equivalent tools for monitoring app health and stability. * Monorepo Development: Comfortable working in Turborepo with shared packages, utilities, and backend adapters. * Proactive Problem Solver: Anticipates and resolves performance and UX challenges early. Technical Innovator: Passionate about adopting new mobile technologies and improving development velocity. * Adaptability: Thrives in a fast\-moving startup environment with evolving priorities and product goals. **Responsibilities** * Application Development: Design, build, and maintain native app features that deliver exceptional performance, scalability, and user experience. * Collaboration: Partner with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to create intuitive, pixel\-perfect mobile experiences. * Testing \& Quality: Write and maintain robust unit and integration tests to ensure code quality and stability. * Performance Optimization: Continuously improve app performance, startup time, and responsiveness. * Feature Ownership: Take ownership of key mobile features or modules from ideation to release. * Architecture Contribution: Participate in technical planning and help shape the future of Fanfix’s mobile architecture and tooling. * Mentorship: Guide and support junior and mid\-level engineers to strengthen the team’s native expertise. Benefits * Compensation: Base salary ($160K \- $230K) \+ Annual Bonus * 100% Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision insurance, including all dependents! * 401k * Generous PTO / paid holidays * Parental leave * Fun working environment at a high growth tech startup! jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: Sapience AI is the collective intelligence platform for professional communities. We sit above the CRMs, AMS platforms, and knowledge bases that organizations already run, and we turn the expertise scattered across them into something every member can search, act on, and share. The intelligence a community needs is already inside it. Most organizations just cannot reach it. Knowledge lives in silos, in legacy systems, in the heads of a few experts, and in fragmented records no one can connect. We change that. Our work is grounded in four commitments: technology elevates people and never replaces them, the best expertise is already inside the community, everything is built on trust, and every deployment is purpose\-driven for the organization it serves. **Let's achieve more, together.** **Where this role sits** ======================== This role owns a product area end to end. Where the product marketer is the market lens, you are the person accountable for what we build, how it works, and whether it ships and succeeds. You lead a cross\-functional team of engineers, designers, and applied AI specialists to turn strategy into a product members rely on. You own the roadmap for your area, the decisions inside it, and the outcomes it produces. You work at the center of the product organization, translating a clear point of view into shipped work that moves MINERVA and the COGENT architecture forward through each GR/GA milestone. **Why this role exists** ======================== In an AI market where capabilities can be copied in weeks, the advantage goes to teams that decide well and ship fast. Someone has to hold the point of view, make the calls, and keep a team building the right thing. Collective intelligence is hard product work: reasoning over messy knowledge, earning member trust, and fitting into how communities already operate. It needs an owner who can hold both the ambition and the details. The Senior Product Manager is that owner. You set direction for your area, make the hard prioritization calls, and are accountable for whether the product succeeds with the people it serves. **What you will own (Areas of Responsibility)** =============================================== You hold eight areas of responsibility inside the product organization. Product strategy and roadmap ownership** ---------------------------------------------- * Own the strategy and roadmap for your product area, grounded in member needs, market evidence, and company goals. * Make clear prioritization calls, and protect the roadmap from reactive churn. * Sequence work so each release builds toward a strategy, not a list of features. **2\. Delivery and execution** ------------------------------ * Lead a cross\-functional team through delivery, unblocking decisions and keeping momentum. * Own trade\-offs on scope, quality, and time, and make them explicit. * Ship reliably, and hold a clear bar for what launch\-ready means. **4\. AI product judgment** --------------------------- * Make sound calls about where AI helps, where it fails, and how to design for its limits. * Design for trust: provenance, guardrails, and honest handling of uncertainty in what the platform tells members. * Partner with applied AI and research to turn capability into dependable product behavior. **5\. Member trust and outcomes** --------------------------------- * Keep member value and trust at the center of every decision. * Define the outcomes your area is accountable for, and measure them honestly. * Own adoption and time\-to\-value, not just shipped features. **6\. Metrics, instrumentation, and learning** ---------------------------------------------- * Instrument your area so you can tell whether a bet is working. * Turn signals into decisions, and shorten the distance from learning to change. * Run experiments where the answer is genuinely uncertain. **7\. Cross\-functional alignment** ----------------------------------- * Align engineering, design, product marketing, and operations around a shared plan and a shared point of view. * Communicate clearly across the company, up and sideways, so people know what is happening and why. * Partner with the product marketer as the market lens, and with go\-to\-market on launch readiness. **8\. Roadmap for platform capability** --------------------------------------- * Advance the underlying platform capability your area depends on, in partnership with platform and architecture teams. * instincts with real members and buyers. * Technical fluency to partner credibly with engineering and applied AI. * Analytical rigor with product metrics and the judgment to separate signal from noise. * Excellent communication and cross\-functional leadership. ***Preferred qualifications*** ------------------------------ * Experience with retrieval, agents, knowledge graphs, or neuro\-symbolic systems. * Experience building trust\-sensitive products with sensitive data. * Familiarity with CRM, AMS, or knowledge\-platform ecosystems. * Domain understanding of professional communities or membership\-driven organizations. * Experience helping define a new product or category. **How you work** ---------------- * You lead with the member and name the real problem before the solution. * You hold a clear, bold point of view and defend it with evidence. * You make hard calls, own them, and keep the team moving. * You treat trust and honesty about AI's limits as first\-order. * You communicate clearly and bring people with you. * You treat learning as the job and change course without ego. **Skills \& Competencies** ========================== * Product strategy, roadmap ownership, and prioritization. * Discovery, problem definition, and validation. * AI product design, including designing for model limits and uncertainty. * Metrics, instrumentation, and experimentation. * Cross\-functional leadership and clear written communication. * Trust, provenance, and governance in AI products. * Balancing customer value with durable platform investment. tightly with Product Marketing as the market lens. jobs.title: Lead DevSecOps Engineer

Reporting to the Vice President of Information Security, this role provides technical leadership for AEG's DevSecOps and Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) programs, driving the integration of security throughout the software development lifecycle. The Lead DevSecOps Engineer partners closely with Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure, and GRC teams to establish secure development standards, strengthen application and cloud security, secure CI/CD pipelines, and advance security automation and continuous compliance capabilities. Serving as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert, this role influences technology strategy, leads cross\-functional security initiatives, and helps improve AEG's overall cybersecurity posture across its global technology environment. This position collaborates with teams across North America and Europe and may require flexibility to support initiatives across multiple time zones. **Essential Functions** * Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) Enablement: + Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the organization's Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) program, partnering with Information Security and Engineering leadership to establish enterprise\-wide secure development standards and practices. + Drive the integration of security\-by\-design principles and automated security controls across the software development lifecycle, ensuring consistent adoption across development, platform, and DevOps teams in collaboration with other engineers; lead security discussions with Engineering, DevOps, and Infrastructure teams to drive adoption of secure development practices. * CI/CD Pipeline Security: + Lead the architecture, strategy, and continuous maturation of enterprise CI/CD security capabilities, establishing secure\-by\-design standards for software delivery pipelines, deployment platforms, and development ecosystems. + Define and govern secure build processes, deployment workflows, container images, and third\-party dependencies; drive and expand automation for security testing, validation, and policy enforcement; establish, integrate, and maintain security controls into build and deployment pipelines to support continuous compliance. * Security Tooling and Monitoring: + Lead the architecture, implementation, and governance of enterprise application security tooling establishing standards for SAST, DAST, and other application security tools. + Oversee the improvement of security visibility and monitoring across development environments; drive the configuration and maintenance alerts, notifications, and security monitoring capabilities. * Risk, Compliance, and Governance Support: + Lead enterprise application risk assessments and threat modeling exercises; establish and maintain the organization's SDLC security requirements, procedures, and supporting documentation. + Document and monitor that compliance efforts align with ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and related frameworks. * Application Security and Vulnerability Management: + Perform secure code reviews and work with development teams to remediate vulnerabilities; manage vulnerability reporting, remediation tracking, and disclosure processes. + Lead remediation efforts across engineering and development teams. * Security Consulting and Cross\-Functional Partnership: + Serve as the lead security advisor and strategic partner with Engineering, DevOps, Platform, Infrastructure, and GRC teams to advance security initiatives. + Lead cross\-functional security initiatives and provide practical security guidance throughout the design, development, and deployment lifecycle. + Define and maintain secure development standards and best practices; serve as a trusted security advisor for application and development\-relate , Cybersecurity, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. security throughout the software development lifecycle, including CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery platforms. * Hands\-on experience with application security testing tools, including SAST, DAST, SCA, and container security solutions. * Experience performing threat modeling, application risk assessments, vulnerability management, and remediation tracking. * Experience implementing monitoring, alerting, and security controls across cloud, application, and infrastructure environments. * Strong understanding of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) practices and secure coding principles. * Familiarity with modern application development frameworks and technologies, including Laravel and other enterprise web application frameworks. * Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to build partnerships and align security objectives with business needs. * Ability to collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams and accommodate occasional meetings across multiple time zones. * Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and adapt to changing priorities in a fast\-paced environment. * Experience with programming languages including JavaScript, Python, Ruby, PHP, or C\#. * Experience with CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI, Azure DevOps, or similar technologies. * Knowledge of application security testing methodologies including SAST, DAST, SCA, and container security scanning. * Experience with OWASP Top 10, NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF), and related security frameworks. * Experience configuring application and infrastructure monitoring solutions, alerts, and notifications. * Familiarity with container technologies and cloud\-native application deployment models. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to work effectively within a highly collaborative global environment. *
