jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure, Platforms and Devices
jobs.description: Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; San Jose, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience programming in C\+\+ or Python. * 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture. * 3 years of experience developing large\-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage or hardware architecture. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field. * 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms. * 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role. * Experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging). **About the job** ----------------- Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. We're building a future where lightweight XR devices pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences. The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Write and test product or system development code. * Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies. * Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency). * Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback. * Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: AI Frameworks Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Great Sky is a technology startup based with a mission to rebuild AI from first principles. We are pursuing neuroscience\-inspired hardware and algorithms that overcome the greatest challenges in scaling AI systems. **The Role** ------------ We are looking for an AI Frameworks Engineer to help build the core software layer that connects our research ideas to working, testable, scalable AI systems. This is a software engineering role focused on the internal AI framework: the abstractions, APIs, graph execution paths, training strategies, validation systems, and test infrastructure that make our research stack usable and reliable. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design, implement, and maintain core AI framework abstractions for defining, training, validating, and executing novel graph\-structured models. * Build clean Python APIs for training workflows, including loss objects, model runtime bundles, optimizer/training strategy interfaces, and more. * Develop and maintain JAX and PyTorch infrastructure for model execution, customizable training protocols, numerical parity tests, and reusable forward\-pass utilities. * Help design validation systems that catch incompatible model/loss/solver/topology combinations early, with clear diagnostics for researchers and production users. * Organize research code into stable, well\-tested framework components without slowing down exploration. * Create clean seams between research\-mode workflows and production harness workflows, so the same infrastructure can support ad hoc experiments, custom training loops, and ticketed/cloud training runs. * Write high\-quality tests for numerical behavior, protocol conformance, registry behavior, graph execution and training loops. * Collaborate closely with researchers and hardware/software engineers to translate evolving research requirements into robust software architecture. * Improve developer ergonomics: documentation, examples, error messages, package organization, type boundaries, and API consistency. * Over time, help shape the broader AI software architecture that connects model design, simulation, training, validation, and hardware execution. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Required:** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * Strong Python software engineering skills, with experience building libraries, frameworks, or infrastructure used by other engineers or researchers. * Hands\-on experience with at least one modern ML framework, especially JAX or PyTorch. * Proficiency with training\-loop internals: forward passes, losses, gradients, optimizers, metrics, parameter/state handling, and numerical testing. * Experience designing clean APIs and abstractions in complex codebases. * Ability to reason about graph\-structured computation, model execution, dependency boundaries, and runtime state. * Strong testing instincts: unit tests, integration tests, regression tests, numerical parity tests, and clear failure modes. * Ability to work in a research\-heavy environment where requirements evolve and the right abstraction often emerges through iteration. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially when translating between research ideas and maintainable engineering designs. **Preferred:** * Prior experience working in an AI technology environment. * Experience with typed Python, protocol\-oriented design, dataclasses, Pydantic, package refactors, or public/internal SDK design. * Familiarity with multi node and multi gpu training for JAX or PyTorch * Experience with custom kernel writing in Triton/Cuda/Pallas * Experience designing plugin or registry systems for losses, optimizers, training strategies, model components, or execution backends. * Experience with compiler\-adjacent or graph\-adjacent systems: computational graphs, schedulers, IRs, topology validation, graph transformations, or hardware\-aware execution. * Experience working near hardware teams, accelerator teams, simulation teams, or low\-level performance work. * Familiarity with containers, cloud execution, job orchestration, experiment tracking, or production training harnesses. **Growth Opportunities** ------------------------ This role has a path toward broad technical ownership within Great Sky’s AI software stack. As the team grows, you may help define framework architecture, set engineering standards, mentor other engineers, and lead major infrastructure projects spanning research workflows, simulation, training, validation, and hardware integration. For the right person, this is a chance to build foundational infrastructure for a new kind of AI platform, rather than incrementally improving an existing transformer/GPU stack. **Benefits and Perks** ---------------------- * Meaningful equity ownership in an early\-stage deep tech company * Employer\-matched 401(k) * Health, dental, vision, and life insurance * Flexible PTO * Support for ongoing learning, conference attendance, and skill development Our culture is onsite by default (we're founded by scientists who are used to working in the lab), with flexibility for hybrid arrangements. For the right person and role, we're open to filling roles remotely Compensation Range: $160K \- $220K

This layer enables execution of models, capability discovery, versioning across hardware generations, and parameter translation to a physical mapping on hardware. * Build a robust experiment framework, so measurement routines are both easy to use and elegantly declared. * Provide the analysis pipelines, capturing maximum value from every inference and measurement. * Present a unified API for both simulated and physical backends. Introducing telemetry, diagnostics, and regression testing that keep the platform trustworthy across hardware revisions. **What Success Looks Like in the First Year** motion stages, or cryogenic systems) * Strong testing instincts: unit, integration, and regression testing, hardware\-in\-the\-loop test design, and simulation/hardware parity testing. * Excellent Quanta Services provides infrastructure services for electric power, pipeline, and communications industries and employees over 50,000 people. Quanta’s focus on the utility industry and HBK’s focus on constructability in our designs has made our integration into the Quanta family of companies seamless. About this Role: An Electrical Distribution Associate Graduate Engineer at HBK Engineering is a role designed for recent engineering graduates entering the professional workforce. This entry\-level position involves providing contract engineering resources to a local electric and gas utility in **Missoula, Montana**. The role supports the company’s expanding efforts to connect new customers to the local utility grid. Additionally, this position provides critical engineering support for existing customers through capacity upgrade projects, system rebuilds, and the relocation of existing utility infrastructure. What You'll Do: * Design engineering systems in compliance with relevant specifications, codes, and client requirements for overhead and subsurface utility projects. * Deploy creative and unique solutions to address a wide variety of complex electrical, structural, civil, and construction\-related challenges. * Own all phases of the design lifecycle from initiation through construction completion and project closeout. * Prepare detailed engineering and construction documents using a variety of software tools including DDS (Distribution Design Studio), GIS systems, Trimble surveying equipment, and client\-specific enterprise asset management platforms. * Analyze information from supplementary data sources including topographical survey, utility atlas information, field sketches, client records, manufacturer equipment datasheets, etc. * Independently manage time and schedule to achieve project milestones. * Perform field walkdowns with internal staff, clients, customers, governance authorities, and construction partners. * Obtain proper permits and easements as required. What You'll Bring: * An ability to work independently and in interdisciplinary teams. * Strong technology skills and an understanding of the Office365 suite of tools. * Working knowledge of 2D CADD software (AutoCAD or similar) including its use to generate layout drawings or other project materials. * Understanding of remote communication software. * Ability to come up to speed quickly on in\-process projects and hit the ground running. * Experience collaborating with a team in order to complete a larger project. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * The persistence to see projects through to completion. * Adaptable to change in a dynamic team environment. **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor of Science in Engineering or related degree from an ABET\-accredited program. * EIT Certification. jobs.title: Customer Service Operations Specialist
jobs.description: The Problem 36 million businesses in America need insurance—it's not optional. 77% are underinsured. 40% have no coverage at all. The distribution system failed them: too slow, too opaque, too confusing. Over 90% of commercial insurance is still human\-led. We're building the inverse: 90%\+ AI\-led, pushing toward the higher 90s. Not by patching legacy workflows—by building AI that makes humans more effective, improves the customer experience, and eliminates friction at every step. We're adding \~1,000 customers per month. We've grown 100x since last year. We're looking to do even more this year—and that's why we're hiring. The accounts that need an expert instead of a script—those are yours. The Thesis Commercial insurance gets complicated fast. A business opens a second location, wins a contract with insurance requirements it doesn't currently meet, adds a fleet, gets hit with a premium audit, grows out of the market it started in, or needs coverage that doesn't exist on a standard form. Those accounts don't need a queue. They need somebody with deep expertise and the latitude to act on it. That's this team. You take the accounts that call for real judgment, you work them directly with the underwriters and wholesalers, and you stay on them until the customer has an answer. Then your expertise becomes the playbook the rest of the service organization runs on, which is how a small team serves a book growing this fast. We're also building this tier now rather than handing you someone else's version of it. Harper's long\-term plan puts service at the center of the company—expertise, retention and revenue all living in one organization—and the specialists we hire first will shape what that looks like. The Role You own our most complex accounts and the hardest customer situations. Premium audits and inspection recommendations that carry real deadlines. Renewals worth remarketing to get a business better terms. E\&S and surplus lines placements, with the filings and binding packets that come with them. Premium finance arrangements and the paperwork behind them. Coverage questions that need someone who can read a policy form and a contract and explain what's actually covered. And the accounts at risk of cancellation, where somebody's coverage is genuinely on the line and a customer needs a person who will solve it. You own relationships too. Every underwriter and wholesaler we work with has a named owner on this team, and you'll be one of them. You're the person they pick up the phone for—and the person who can get a real answer for a customer because you've built that credibility over years. You're the last stop inside service, which means nothing you pick up gets handed to somebody else to figure out. You have the latitude to make the call, and when something genuinely needs a founder's decision you bring it to them with your recommendation attached. Complex cases get answers in days here, not weeks. What You'll Do Own the complex accounts end to end — The situations that need experience rather than a script; you keep them until the customer has a real answer Work the markets on your customers' behalf — Partner with underwriters and wholesalers to place hard risks, remarket renewals for better terms, and find a home for businesses standard markets won't write Guide customers through audits and inspections — Premium audits, payroll and sales verification, inspection recommendations with deadlines; make sure the final number and the required changes are right and understood Handle E\&S and surplus lines work — Eligibility, filings, surplus lines tax, binding packets, and the documentation that has to be correct the first time Make coverage match the business — Businesses change constantly: new locations, vehicles, payroll, equipment, and contracts with new requirements; keep coverage, class codes and records current as they grow Save accounts worth saving — Work payment, financing and cancellation situations with the customer and the finance company so coverage stays in force Be the name your carriers know — Own specific underwriter and wholesaler relationships and build the kind of credibility that gets customers a better outcome Level up the team around you — Turn what you know into playbooks, train the service team, and grow the tier\-two group into people who can handle more every month Make the system smarter — Work in our service workbench daily and tell Product and Engineering what to automate, so your expertise scales past your own calendar You Might Be a Fit If... You're the person colleagues bring the case nobody else can crack You have real relationships with underwriters and wholesalers—and they take your call You'd rather decide with the facts you have and document your reasoning than let an account sit for three weeks You're tired of needing three approvals to do the obviously right thing You can hold a case open for days without losing the thread, and keep twenty of them straight You're curious about AI tools and want to tell engineers what to build, not wait for permission You want to build this function, not inherit someone else's version of it You know startup pace is a real adjustment from a traditional brokerage and you want it anyway Requirements 5\+ years in commercial lines underwriting, account executive, wholesale brokerage, or carrier\-side roles Active property \& casualty license—we handle non\-resident and reciprocal licensing across all 50 states Existing carrier and wholesaler relationships you can put to work A track record owning complex commercial cases end to end, not just triaging them Comfort with technology; you'll work in our service workbench daily and be expected to tell us where it falls short Based in New York City or San Francisco, or willing to relocate; this role is in\-office Nice to Have Surplus lines license E\&S experience: surplus lines tax, filings, binding packets, DocuSign workflows Premium finance depth: PFAs, reconciliation, finance\-company defaults and cancellation reversals Workers' comp and class\-code expertise, including NCCI audit disputes Wholesaler, MGA or carrier underwriting\-desk background Experience at an insurtech or tech\-forward brokerage Compensation Salary: $110,000–$150,000 \+ performance bonuses \+ equity Location: San Francisco, Atlanta, or New York City, in\-office Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8 AM – 8 PM ET. The hours are long. The learning curve is steep. The people who thrive here wouldn't have it any other way. Start date: Immediate Benefits Health, dental, and vision insurance Commuter benefits Team meals and snacks The Process People screen — Initial fit and alignment Founder screen — Insurance judgment, operating instinct, and culture fit Super day — Work through real cases with the team and see how you operate To Apply If you've spent years making the hard calls and watching them get second\-guessed by people who couldn't make them, this is the seat where the decision is yours. Send your resume and tell us about the messiest commercial account you ever untangled—what was wrong, who you had to move, and how it ended. Compensation Range: $110K \- $150K

At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime. **Role Overview** ----------------- The cloud platform underpins how services are built, deployed, and operated across the organization. As adoption scales, **cost visibility, allocation, and optimization must be engineered into the platform**, not managed reactively. As a **Senior Cloud FinOps Platform Engineer**, you will **lead the development and evolution of the cost management capabilities of the cloud platform**—ensuring teams can understand, attribute, and optimize their cloud usage through standardized, automated, and self\-service mechanisms. This role operates at the **platform layer**, embedding FinOps practices into **cloud foundations, guardrails, and automation workflows**, rather than managing costs through manual reporting or one\-off analysis. You will provide technical leadership for cloud optimization initiatives and help establish reusable FinOps patterns and standards across the organization. Success in this role means cost management becomes **predictable, transparent, actionable, and scalable**, with measurable financial outcomes and decreasing operational overhead. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ ### **Build Cost\-Aware Platform Foundations** * **Design and evolve cost allocation standards** (tagging, labeling, account structure) across cloud environments * Embed cost insight into platform provisioning workflows and templates * Ensure cloud resources are created with **consistent, enforceable cost attribution** ### **Expand Cost Visibility \& Tooling** * **Lead the integration and ongoing development of cloud cost platforms and automation such as Flexera, CloudZero, or equivalent aggregation tools, and cost optimization tools like ProsperOps** * Enable **cross\-cloud cost visibility**, unit cost analysis, and business\-level attribution, including a **showback model** * Build and maintain **cost dashboards, alerts, budgets, and reporting pipelines** for engineering and stakeholders * Improve visibility into shared services, platform costs, and unallocated spend * **Evaluate emerging FinOps capabilities and recommend improvements based on measurable platform and business value** ### **Embed FinOps into Platform Automation** * **Define and implement patterns for integrating** cost controls into **Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) and CI/CD workflows** * Automate detection of cost anomalies, unused resources, and optimization opportunities * Ensure cost guardrails are enforced through **policy and automation**, not manual review * **Identify recurring manual FinOps activities and drive their replacement with scalable automation** ### **Enable Cost\-Aware Engineering** * Partner with engineering teams to improve **cost transparency and accountability** * Provide guidance on **cost\-efficient usage patterns** aligned with platform standards * **Establish** documentation, examples, and reference patterns for cost\-aware design * **Mentor engineers and help teams incorporate cloud economics into architecture and engineering decisions** ### **Improve Cost Efficiency Over Time** * Identify systemic cost inefficiencies and **lead platform\-level improvements** * **Drive automation and adoption of** rightsizing, reservation strategies, and usage optimization patterns * Work with Finance and platform leadership to align **forecasting, budgeting, and usage trends** * **Measure realized savings and optimization outcomes against forecasts and recommendations** ### **Vendor Optimization \& Commitment Management** * **Lead the technical evaluation** and integration of supplier\-provided recommendations within platform automation and governance workflows * **Evaluate commitment strategies** such as Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, and equivalent offerings against usage patterns, forecasts, architecture changes, and business risk * Translate vendor insights into **repeatable, scalable optimization patterns** * Partner with our cloud providers to **identify new optimization opportunities** and validate realized outcomes **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- ### **Experience \& Skills** * **5–8\+ years of experience** in cloud engineering, DevOps, FinOps, platform engineering, or related technical disciplines * Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) * Solid understanding of cloud cost drivers, billing models, usage patterns, and optimization strategies * Experience with **Infrastructure\-as\-Code and automation tools** (Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, etc.) * Experience evaluating and implementing **cloud commitment models** (Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, or equivalents) * Experience working with **cost optimization vendors or managed FinOps platforms** ### **FinOps \& Tooling** * Experience with cloud cost tools such as **Flexera, CloudZero, CloudHealth, ProsperOps,** or native cloud cost platforms * Experience with cost allocation strategies (tagging, chargeback/showback models) * Good understanding of FinOps lifecycle principles (Inform, Optimize, Operate) * **Ability to translate cost and usage data into actionable engineering and platform recommendations** ### **Engineering \& Collaboration** * Strong systems thinking and ability to work at the platform level * Ability to translate technical usage into **financial insight and measurable business outcomes** * Experience working across engineering, Finance, cloud providers, vendors, and platform teams * Ability to lead technical initiatives and influence standards without direct authority * **Experience mentoring engineers** and sharing technical practices across teams * Clear communication and documentation skills In You'll set technical direction, drive complex initiatives end to end, and mentor the broader team. Come help us build the future of network operations. **What You'll Do:** ------------------- * Own the architecture, build, and roadmap for our Juniper/Mist campus and branch infrastructure, and lead its evolution across sites and business units. * Lead the Palo Alto Networks security stack, from policy architecture to secure\-by\-design standards across teams. * Own end\-to\-end AWS cloud network implementation — VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect/VPN, Route 53 — and hybrid connectivity, including BGP, OSPF, and SD\-WAN traffic engineering at scale. * Drive automation and AI adoption across network operations, from config deployment to AI\-powered monitoring, observability, and root\-cause analysis. * Be the go\-to for critical issues, and mentor less\-experienced engineers through code review, troubleshooting, and skill\-building. **What You'll Bring:** ---------------------- * 10\+ years in enterprise network engineering — routing, switching, wireless — with deep expertise in Juniper (EX/QFX/SRX, Mist) and/or Cisco (Catalyst, Nexus), plus hands\-on work with intelligent ops tools like Mist/Marvis at scale. * Expert\-level BGP, OSPF, SD\-WAN, and load balancing chops. jobs.description: We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime. Reliable workplace technology enables teams to do their best work. This role focuses on maintaining and improving that reliability across devices, collaboration systems, and workplace technology environments. The Workplace Technology Support Engineer \- Executive Support helps maintain the stability, performance, and continuous improvement of workplace technology across the organization, with a main focus on our executive leadership team. This will serve as the main point of contact for issues in the executive space. The role **will need to be available to travel** to support events, shows, presentations, and calls. authentication workflows. * Experience using service management platforms such as ServiceNow or similar tools. * Ability to analyze sophisticated technical issues, identify root causes, and communicate solutions clearly. * Strong documentation skills and a history of creating runbooks, playbooks, or knowledge base articles. * Experience identifying trends, improving processes, or consistency of endpoint and workplace technology systems. * Identifies patterns, trends, and opportunities for improvement, including automation and process optimization. * Produces clear jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Data Products
jobs.description: **Highlight is the definitive product intelligence platform enabling brands to create products people love.** Powered by a proprietary community, seamless logistics, expert research methodologies, and AI\-driven analytics, Highlight’s platform is purpose\-built for modern physical product teams and trusted by leading brands, top retailers, and emerging innovators alike. The Highlight platform delivers high\-impact insights with unmatched quality across every stage of the product innovation lifecycle—from early ideas and prototypes to in\-market renovation—empowering teams to act quickly and bring winning products to market with confidence. **About the role** As a Staff Software Engineer on our Data Products team, you'll own the architecture and execution of data\-intensive systems that power insights for our customers. You'll balance hands\-on technical leadership with mentorship, setting the technical bar for how we build at scale while shipping features that directly impact product strategy and customer value. Success means delivering performant, maintainable systems while growing the engineering team's capabilities and understanding of complex data challenges. **Working at Highlight** At Highlight, you’ll be joining a high\-velocity, high\-ownership culture that measures itself by our positive impact on our customers and the world (not story points). To help make our mission a reality, you’ll:* Use your technical expertise and good judgment to translate ideas, wireframes, and detailed designs into data\-intensive web applications that deliver value for our customers * Use agentic loops throughout your development process to accelerate value delivery * Use architecture and code reviews to coach, mentor, and raise the bar for both end\-user products and software systems * Triage, investigate, and resolve complex issues involving distributed systems and third\-party providers * Understand and directly advance Highlight’s mission **What We're Looking For** Highlight was founded to make the hardest parts of physical product testing easy. Even if you’re new to the space, we’d love to see your own experience turning rough ideas into polished, usable data products. That may include:* 5\+ years of experience building data\-intensive online applications * Familiarity with ETL and/or RAG design and development * Proficiency in multiple technologies across our software stack (React, TypeScript, Next.JS, ai\-sdk, PostgreSQL, and C\#/.NET) * Familiarity with design and prototyping tools like Figma and v0 * Bonus points for experience operating CI/CD pipelines (we use Github Actions, Terraform, and helm), production systems (AWS, EKS) or observability platforms (Grafana/OTel) aligned with our stack. #### **Beyond Your Experience** We’re building a culture that will serve Highlight far beyond our current, early stage, and all of us have a big part to play. To that end, we prize humans who are:* Owners. You’ll take initiative, deliver results, and inspire the people around you to do the same. * Impact\-driven. You’ll understand your users’ needs and take ownership in delivering value on their behalf * Great teammates. You’ll share our team’s commitment to learning and growth and thrive in collaboration with the humans around you * Curious. You’ll go the extra mile to understand the “why” behind your work, seeing ambiguity and open questions as opportunities to learn and overdeliver **Benefits** * Health insurance (medical, dental, vision) with 100% of employee premiums covered * Unlimited PTO * Flexible, remote WFH culture * Generous paid maternity \& parental leave * 401k account * $50/month WFH reimbursement * Based on previous experience and skillset, the starting salary range for this position is $170,000 \- $210,000

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** ================== As a Sales Engineer, you will operate as a lighter\-weight forward deployed engineer embedded in our go\-to\-market motion — part builder, part consultant. You will sit at the intersection of sales, product, and AI: writing code to prototype agentic demos, configuring use\-case\-specific agent flows, and then walking into the room to present them to clinical, commercial, and technical stakeholders. This is a role for an engineer who wants to be client\-facing — someone who can build with their hands and communicate with executive polish. You will partner with sales leadership on strategic pursuits across pharma and health systems, turning complex AI capabilities into demos and narratives that make prospects say "I need this." This role is based full\-time in our Menlo Park, CA office. **What You'll Do** ================== * Build and deliver tailored, high\-impact demos of our agentic AI platform — hands\-on prototyping of agent flows, scripts, and demo environments mapped to each prospect’s clinical and commercial workflows. * Write code where it moves deals forward: demo scaffolding, light integrations, data mocking, and rapid proofs of concept with LLM and agentic tooling. * Own the technical narrative in sales cycles — presentations, solution architectures, and ROI stories built alongside sales leadership. * Run discovery and scoping with prospects, translating requirements into agent and solution designs the way a consultant would structure an engagement. * Serve as the technical voice in the room — answering product, integration, and AI safety questions with credibility and clarity. * Support pilots and proofs of concept hands\-on, bridging the gap between what was sold and what gets deployed. * Feed field insights back to Product and ML teams to sharpen the platform and the pitch. **What You Bring** ================== **Must\-Have:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. * 3–5 years of experience spanning software engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions/sales engineering, or technical consulting. * Ability to code — comfortable in Python or JavaScript, working with APIs, and prototyping with LLM\-based or agentic systems. * Consulting\-grade client presence: structured thinking, executive\-level presentations, and the ability to run a room. * Strong storytelling and communication skills; able to make complex technology simple for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Self\-starter who thrives in fast\-moving, ambiguous, high\-growth environments. * Commitment to safety, ethics, and patient\-centered outcomes. **Nice\-to\-Have:** * Forward deployed engineering, management consulting, or client\-embedded delivery experience. * Experience in healthcare, pharma, or life sciences technology. * Familiarity with conversational AI, voice agents, or agentic workflows. * Experience supporting enterprise sales cycles with multiple stakeholders. **Why Join Hippocratic AI** --------------------------- **Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first.** We’re building the world’s first healthcare‑only, safety‑focused LLM — a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation. **Work with the people shaping the future.** Hippocratic AI was co‑founded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA. **Backed by the world’s leading healthcare and AI investors.** We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3\.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Children’s, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others. **Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI.** Join experts who’ve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building world‑changing technologies — ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Hippocratic AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a team that reflects the patients we serve. We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you require accommodations during the hiring process, please contact people@hippocraticai.com. ***Please be aware of recruitment scams impersonating Hippocratic AI. All recruiting communication will come from @******hippocraticai.com*** ***email addresses. We will never request payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.***

jobs.title: Data Center Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **Function** Product **Our Company** =============== We’re Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world’s innovators. Our resilient, high\-performance data infrastructure means that customers – from banks to theme parks – can focus on achieving the incredible with data. If you’ve seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you’ve seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate – and wow their customers. Right now, we’re laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We’re looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team – and who get excited about making a real\-world impact with data. **Job description** =================== **Position Overview** Hitachi Vantara is expanding its Engineering Data Center Lab infrastructure in Norman, Oklahoma as part of a multi\-year consolidation of its U.S. engineering lab footprint. We are seeking an experienced **Data Center Infrastructure Engineer** to provide hands\-on infrastructure support and execution for the Norman Engineering Lab. This role will support the deployment, migration, operation, troubleshooting, maintenance, and lifecycle management of compute, storage, networking, and supporting data center infrastructure used by global engineering and product teams. **Key Responsibilities** * Install, rack, cable, relocate, troubleshoot, repair, and decommission enterprise compute, storage, and network equipment. * Participate in hardware migrations, infrastructure deployments, lab expansions, and consolidation activities. * Execute approved implementation plans and infrastructure changes. * Troubleshoot server, storage, network, power, cabling, optics, firmware, and hardware connectivity issues. * Support console access, BMC, iLO, iDRAC, IPMI, firmware updates, hardware validation, and remote\-hands requests. * Install and maintain copper and fiber connectivity, rails, cable\-management components, and related rack infrastructure. * Validate rack space, power, connectivity, cabling, and deployment readiness before installation. * Maintain accurate rack elevations, asset records, serial numbers, equipment locations, and cabling documentation. * Create and update incidents, service requests, work items, and change records with accurate technical details. * Work with Network, Systems, Storage, Product Services, Engineering, Facilities, and global technical teams. * Support hardware staging, shipping, receiving, inventory, return, and disposal activities. * Follow established safety, security, change\-management, and operational procedures. * Identify discrepancies or risks and escalate before making changes. * Create and maintain implementation documentation, procedures, and runbooks. Participate in planned maintenance and occasional after\-hours activities as required. * **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of experience supporting enterprise data centers, engineering labs, infrastructure environments, or similar operations. * Strong hands\-on experience with enterprise compute, storage, networking, and physical data center infrastructure. * Experience supporting hardware migrations, infrastructure deployments, relocations, or consolidation activities. * Strong understanding of rack layouts, structured cabling, fiber optics, A/B power, PDUs, and equipment installation practices. * Experience troubleshooting hardware, network connectivity, storage connectivity, cabling, and related infrastructure issues. * Experience with enterprise Ethernet, Fibre Channel, and remote hardware\-management technologies. * Ability to interpret implementation plans, rack elevations, network diagrams, and technical documentation. * Experience with ticketing, change\-management, asset\-management, inventory, CMDB, or DCIM systems. * Ability to independently execute routine and moderately complex infrastructure work. * Strong documentation, organizational, and communication skills. * Ability to recognize operational risk and escalate appropriately. * Ability to safely install and move data center equipment. Ability to work onsite in Norman, Oklahoma. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Hitachi Vantara infrastructure technologies. * Experience with Cisco, Brocade, Dell, HPE, Lenovo, VMware, Red Hat, or comparable enterprise platforms. * Working knowledge of Linux and Windows Server environments. * Experience with virtualization platforms. * Experience with DCIM, CMDB, monitoring, asset\-management, or capacity\-management systems. * Experience supporting engineering, development, quality\-assurance, high\-density compute, GPU, or AI environments. * Relevant infrastructure, networking, systems, virtualization, cloud, or data center certifications. Familiarity with Python, PowerShell, Bash, Ansible, APIs, or similar automation technologies a plus. * **Tools \& Platforms** * Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams. * Microsoft Visio or similar diagramming tools. * ITSM and work\-management platforms such as: + Jira Software + Jira Service Management + Confluence + ServiceNow Experience creating, updating, and closing incidents, service requests, work items, and change records. * As required by the equal pay and transparency acts, the expected base salary for this position is: $60K to $75K. The expected on\-target earnings for this position is: $65K to $82K The expected pay is determined based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, depth of experience in the practice area. Employees are eligible to participate in Hitachi Vantara’s bonus/variable/commission pay programs, where applicable, and are subject to the program’s conditions and restrictions. \#LI\-JT1 **About us** ============ We’re a global team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion for insight to co\-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data\-driven leaders that can a make positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can inspire the future, this is the place to fulfil your purpose and achieve your potential. **Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives** ===================================================== Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth. We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit\-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work. **How we look after you** ========================= We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry\-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We’re also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We’re always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you’ll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with. We’re proud to say we’re an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic. Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Minnesota \- Data Engineer #### **Hollstadt Overview** Hollstadt Consulting is a management and technology consulting firm dedicated to placing professionals at engagements where they will excel. When you work with us, you'll work with a refreshingly real company led and staffed by seasoned experts who are also down\-to\-earth, good people. We're committed to treating you with respect and helping you achieve your career aspirations. Since 1990, Hollstadt has been a trusted partner to more than 150 domestic and global companies and has successfully completed over 3,000 projects. Our continued growth has created challenging and rewarding opportunities for accomplished IT and Business Consultants. Hollstadt Consulting is an equal opportunity employer including disability/veteran. *By applying for this job, you agree to receive calls, AI\-generated calls, text messages, or emails from Hollstadt Consulting and its affiliates, and contracted partners. Frequency varies for text messages. Message and data rates may apply. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. You can reply STOP to cancel at any time.* **Job Description** **Role**: Data Engineer **Location**: Remote **Duration**: 6\-12 months (extension possible) **Rate**: $52\.51/hour W2 **1\. Engagement Overview** The client has selected **Globus** as a strategic Managed File Transfer (MFT) platform to address critical gaps in secure, large\-scale research data movement. The Globus platform is currently being installed in the **GCP Cloud Data DMZ** and is nearing completion of initial implementation. The Enterprise Interfaces team within the Enterprise Data organization has been designated as the **operational home** for Globus, alongside existing MFT solutions (Signiant and Cleo). The contractor will embed within the Enterprise Interfaces team and serve as the **primary technical resource** for completing Globus operationalization, onboarding initial research customers, establishing operational support processes, and building the team's institutional knowledge of the Globus ecosystem. This engagement is designed to bridge an immediate capacity gap while the organization plans for long\-term staffing through Phase 2 positions. **2\. Project Context** This engagement directly supports enterprise priorities including: * **Research Enablement** – Enabling secure, compliant, high\-throughput transfer of large research datasets (terabyte\- to petabyte\-scale) for Principal Investigator onboarding/offboarding, grant collaborations, and secure data downloads from approved external sites. * **MFT Consolidation** – Integrating Globus into the existing MFT portfolio alongside Signiant and Cleo, with a long\-term vision toward consolidated MFT operations with an AI\-operations\-centric approach. * **Security \& Compliance** – Ensuring alignment with internal ISA, BAA, TPRM, and NIST security framework requirements. **Key Architectural Elements:** * Globus SaaS control plane with user authentication via Entra ID (restricted to allowed identity providers) * Two internally hosted Compute Engine VMs running Globus Connect Server (GCS) v5 in the GCP Data DMZ * GCP ingress and egress S3 storage buckets with a defined 30\-day data lifecycle/retention rule * GridFTP parallel transfer protocol across HTTPS 443 and TCP ports 50000–51000 for high\-performance data movement * Globus Storage Gateways (Google S3 connectors) linking collections to GCP bucket storage * Data movement performed by Globus\-managed service accounts — no direct user access to underlying buckets * User provisioning managed via Sailpoint * Flat\-fee licensing model for unlimited data transfer and unlimited endpoints (cloud and on\-premises) **3\. Scope of Work / Key Responsibilities** The contractor will be responsible for, but not limited to, the following: **Platform Configuration \& Deployment Completion** * Complete final configuration and hardening of the Globus Connect Server (GCS v5\) deployment on GCP Compute Engine VMs within the Data DMZ * Configure and validate Globus Storage Gateways and S3 Storage Connectors for ingress and egress GCP buckets * Configure Globus collections (Managed and Guest) aligned with client's data access policies and identity provider restrictions * Validate end\-to\-end data transfer workflows including ingress, egress, and staging collection transfers across the Service Connector (SC) boundary into the MCC VPC * Configure DNS, authentication flows (OAuth/OpenID Connect via Entra ID), and endpoint registration within Globus.org **User Onboarding \& Research Customer Support** * Onboard initial research user groups to the Globus platform, providing hands\-on support for first transfers * Develop and document standardized user onboarding procedures, including Sailpoint provisioning workflows and Globus Web App access * Provide Tier 1/2 operational support for Globus users — troubleshooting transfer failures, stalled transfers, permission issues, connectivity ice\-to\-Have Skills** * Experience deploying Globus in a healthcare or regulated environment (HIPAA, NIST) * Familiarity with Azure DevOps (ADO) for config/state management and CI/CD pipelines * Experience with Terraform / Infrastructure as Code for GCP resource provisioning * Knowledge of Sailpoint or similar identity governance platforms for user provisioning * Experience with Entra ID (Azure AD) federation and SSO integration * Familiarity with High\-Performance Computing (HPC) environments and research data workflows * Experience with monitoring/observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, GCP Cloud Monitoring) * Understanding of Box.com integration patterns (Globus \+ Box complementary architecture) **6\. Other Requirements** * **Self\-directed problem solver** – Identifies issues, researches solutions, and proposes fixes without waiting for detailed instructions. Globus troubleshooting often requires deep dives into different layers of the stack (application, performance, networking, user\-support). * **Strong communicator** – Able to explain complex technical concepts to both technical staff and research customers; produces clear, concise documentation. * **Enables others** – Actively transfers knowledge to internal team members; creates operational runbooks and training materials that enable the team to assume full ownership. * **Customer\-oriented** – Comfortable working directly with research users to troubleshoot issues and guide them through data transfer workflows. * **Governance\-aware** – Navigates internal change management, approval processes, and security review requirements effectively. * **Proactive** – Anticipates operational needs, identifies process improvements, and proposes solutions for long\-term platform sustainability. **Required Education**: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering from an accredited University or College. * OR * Associate’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering from an accredited University or College with two (2\) years of experience. ### **Benefits \+ Perks** Comprehensive Benefit Plan Hollstadt offers medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short\-term disability, long\-term disability, paid sick leave, and retirement benefits to eligible employees. With three different medical plans to choose from, you can enroll in the coverage you need from individual to family, or anywhere in between! Remarketing Process Hollstadt is based on retention and relationships. We get to know your strengths and career wishes throughout your assignment and then start remarket discussions 6\-8 weeks prior to your end date. By being proactive, we are able to keep your down time between assignments as short as possible, unless you choose otherwise. Professional Development Hollstadt offers on\-demand training through our consultant portal. Trainings give our consultants the continuing education they need to excel on their projects. Many of our courses apply towards continuing education credits and we have an entire training hub dedicated to upskilling in Artificial Intelligence (AI). 401k \+ Matching One popular benefit is our 401(k) match on the first 4% of your contributions. Hollstadt wants to help you reach your long\-term financial goals and understands that planning for your future is critical. Consultants also have access to support from a Financial Advisor. Bonus Opportunities We appreciate and reward loyalty. Join Hollstadt, stay for 5 years, and we’ll give you a $5,000 Longevity Award bonus! Additionally, we know great talent knows other great talent. If you are on contract with Hollstadt and refer one of your connections who gets placed, we’ll pay you $1,000! Ongoing Support \& Networking We have made a significant investment in building a support program for our consultant team \- so you never have to feel like you are going it alone. We also have a Consultant Coach program which acts like a 'work buddy' to provide a safe ear for questions or concerns at your client site.

The ideal candidate will be passionate about artificial intelligence, natural language processing, and large language models (LLMs), with the ability to design, develop, and deploy GenAI\-driven solutions that transform business processes and enhance productivity. You will collaborate cross\-functionally with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to bring creative AI concepts to life, leveraging tools like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Vertex AI, or similar platforms. **Experience Required:** 4\+ years **Key Responsibilities:** * Design and develop applications and workflows using **Generative AI** and **Large Language Models (LLMs)**. * Fine\-tune pre\-trained models to meet specific business needs and improve performance. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify opportunities for AI\-driven innovation. * Build prompt engineering strategies to optimize model outputs. * Research and prototype new approaches in text, image, and multimodal generation. * Implement scalable GenAI solutions using APIs and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). * Evaluate and monitor AI model accuracy, bias, and performance metrics. * Stay up to date with the latest trends in GenAI, NLP, and machine learning technologies. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. * 4 \+ years of experience in AI/ML development with a focus on **Generative AI** and **NLP**. * Strong understanding of transformer\-based architectures (e.g., GPT, LLaMA, Claude, Gemini). * Hands\-on experience with **Python**, **LangChain**, **Hugging Face**, or **OpenAI API**. * Experience integrating GenAI models into real\-world applications or enterprise systems. * Proficiency in cloud computing environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure). * Strong problem\-solving and creative thinking skills. **Preferred Skills:** * Experience with multimodal AI (text, image, or audio generation). * Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma). * Exposure to prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation), and LLMOps. * Excellent communication skills and ability to explain complex AI concepts in simple terms. **Why Join Us:** * Work with cutting\-edge AI tools and technologies. * Collaborative and innovative environment that values experimentation. * Opportunities to shape the future of AI\-driven business transformation.

The ideal candidate will be passionate about artificial intelligence, natural language processing, and large language models (LLMs), with the ability to design, develop, and deploy GenAI\-driven solutions that transform business processes and enhance productivity. You will collaborate cross\-functionally with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to bring creative AI concepts to life, leveraging tools like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Vertex AI, or similar platforms. **Experience Required:** 4\+ years **Key Responsibilities:** * Design and develop applications and workflows using **Generative AI** and **Large Language Models (LLMs)**. * Fine\-tune pre\-trained models to meet specific business needs and improve performance. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify opportunities for AI\-driven innovation. * Build prompt engineering strategies to optimize model outputs. * Research and prototype new approaches in text, image, and multimodal generation. * Implement scalable GenAI solutions using APIs and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). * Evaluate and monitor AI model accuracy, bias, and performance metrics. * Stay up to date with the latest trends in GenAI, NLP, and machine learning technologies. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. * 4 \+ years of experience in AI/ML development with a focus on **Generative AI** and **NLP**. * Strong understanding of transformer\-based architectures (e.g., GPT, LLaMA, Claude, Gemini). * Hands\-on experience with **Python**, **LangChain**, **Hugging Face**, or **OpenAI API**. * Experience integrating GenAI models into real\-world applications or enterprise systems. * Proficiency in cloud computing environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure). * Strong problem\-solving and creative thinking skills. **Preferred Skills:** * Experience with multimodal AI (text, image, or audio generation). * Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma). * Exposure to prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation), and LLMOps. * Excellent communication skills and ability to explain complex AI concepts in simple terms. **Why Join Us:** * Work with cutting\-edge AI tools and technologies. * Collaborative and innovative environment that values experimentation. * Opportunities to shape the future of AI\-driven business transformation.

jobs.title: IOS Developer - USC and GC Full Time Role
jobs.description: **Job Overview** We are seeking a passionate and motivated iOS Developer with 6 months to 4 years of experience in developing mobile applications for Apple devices. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of iOS development, be willing to work in an onsite or hybrid environment, and be open to relocating anywhere within the United States. **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Work Authorization:** US Citizens and Green Card holders only **Experience Required:** 4\+ Years **Work Mode:** Onsite / Hybrid **Relocation:** Must be open to relocate anywhere in the United States **Key Responsibilities** * Design and develop high\-quality iOS applications using Swift and/or Objective\-C * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including UI/UX designers, product managers, and backend developers * Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices * Integrate RESTful APIs and third\-party libraries * Perform unit testing and debugging to ensure application stability * Participate in code reviews and Agile/Scrum ceremonies * Maintain and enhance existing iOS applications **Required Skills** * Strong knowledge of **Swift** (Objective\-C is a plus) * Experience with **Xcode**, iOS SDK, and Interface Builder * Understanding of **UIKit**, Auto Layout, and Apple Human Interface Guidelines * Experience integrating **REST APIs** and handling JSON data * Knowledge of **Git** or other version control systems * Familiarity with **MVVM/MVC architecture patterns** * Basic understanding of App Store deployment process **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Core Data, Realm, or other local storage solutions * Exposure to CI/CD pipelines * Knowledge of unit testing frameworks (XCTest) * Understanding of mobile app performance optimization

jobs.title: Windows Server System Admin I
jobs.description: **Position Title: Windows System Admin I** **Location: West Point, GA** **On\-site (5 days)** **Position Overview** Hyundai AutoEver America is seeking a **System Administrator I** to support server administration, Manufacturing Execution Systems, endpoint support, backup operations, patch management, and daily infrastructure monitoring within a manufacturing technology environment. This role is responsible for helping maintain reliable IT operations that support business users and production systems. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with Windows desktop and server environments, basic Linux administration knowledge, strong troubleshooting skills, and a customer\-focused approach to technical support. The System Administrator I will work closely with internal teams, senior technical staff, and vendors to help minimize downtime, support MES availability, complete routine system maintenance, and document operational procedures. **Key Responsibilities** **Server Administration*** Support and maintain Windows and Linux server environments. * Perform routine server administration and maintenance tasks. * Monitor server health, performance, and availability. * Assist with operating system updates, upgrades, and system maintenance activities. * Maintain server documentation and inventory records. * Support Active Directory user and group administration. * Assist with DNS, DHCP, and general infrastructure support as needed. **Manufacturing Execution Systems Support*** Provide first\-line infrastructure support for Manufacturing Execution Systems. * Monitor MES\-related servers, services, and system availability. * Assist with troubleshooting MES connectivity, performance, and operational issues. * Escalate production\-impacting issues to senior team members or vendors when necessary. * Support MES maintenance activities, system testing, and production support efforts. * Participate in efforts to minimize production downtime and maintain continuous assembly line operations. **Backup and Recovery Operations*** Monitor daily backup jobs and investigate backup failures. * Perform data restoration requests as directed. * Verify backup completion, job status, and system health. * Maintain backup documentation, procedures, and operational records. **Patch Management*** Deploy and monitor desktop and server patching activities. * Verify successful installation of security updates. * Assist with vulnerability remediation efforts. * Document patching activities, maintenance work, and related system changes. **Monitoring and Daily Operations*** Perform daily infrastructure monitoring and operational checks. * Respond to system alerts, service notifications, and user\-reported issues. * Assist with troubleshooting server, workstation, and application issues. * Document incidents, resolutions, and operational procedures. * Escalate issues when they are outside the scope of the role or require additional support. **Endpoint and User Support*** Troubleshoot workstation hardware and software issues. * Support operating systems, printers, peripherals, scanners, and mobile devices. * Assist users with technical issues and service requests. * Support software installations, deployments, and basic configuration tasks. * Provide timely and professional customer service to internal users. **Automation and Process Improvement*** Assist with automation initiatives using PowerShell, Bash, or similar scripting tools. * Support process improvement efforts to increase operational efficiency. * Maintain documentation for automated procedures, scripts, and technical solutions. **Project Support*** Assist with infrastructure and technology projects. * Support equipment deployments and system implementations. * Participate in testing, validation, and system readiness activities. * Maintain project documentation as assigned. **Required Qualifications*** Associate degree in Information Technology or equivalent experience. * 3 to 5 years of experience in the IT field preferred. * Experience supporting Windows desktop and server environments. * Basic Linux administration knowledge. * Understanding of Active Directory, DNS, and DHCP. * Knowledge of backup concepts and patch management processes. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Strong customer service skills with the ability to support internal users professionally. * Ability to work independently and as part of a team. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office. * Ability to support a 24x5 or 24x6 operational environment as needed. * Ability to work overtime when required. * Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs. **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience supporting Manufacturing Execution Systems, preferably in an automotive or manufacturing environment. * Experience with VMware or Hyper\-V environments. * Familiarity with Microsoft 365 administration. * PowerShell, Bash, or other scripting experience. * Experience in manufacturing, production, or plant support environment. * Understanding of IT service management, incident management, and change control processes. * Experience documenting technical procedures, incidents, and resolutions. * Familiarity with ASP.NET and WinForms is a plus. **Environment Supported** This position will help support a technology environment that includes:* Windows and Linux servers. * Manufacturing Execution Systems. * Endpoint and workstation support. * Backup and recovery systems. * Microsoft 365 services. * Manufacturing and business applications. * Infrastructure monitoring, patching, and operational support tools. **Key Success Factors** A successful System Administrator I will:* Help maintain reliable operation of server and endpoint infrastructure. * Support MES availability and manufacturing operations. * Complete backup, patching, and monitoring activities accurately and on schedule. * Provide timely resolution of infrastructure and user issues. * Maintain accurate documentation and operational records. * Escalate issues appropriately and communicate clearly with stakeholders. * Demonstrate continuous technical growth and a process\-improvement mindset. In addition to a competitive salary, this position offers a fantastic benefits package that includes comprehensive medical/dental coverage, generous PTO, education assistance, and annual merit increase eligibility in a growth\-focused work environment. **Team Culture:** Our team fosters a collaborative, solutions\-driven environment where technical expertise and business impact go hand in hand. We value proactive problem\-solving, continuous learning, and strong communication, empowering engineers to take ownership of network performance, security, and innovation while working closely with cross\-functional partners. * **Collaborative \& Cross\-Functional:** Work closely with security, systems, and development teams to solve complex challenges and deliver reliable network solutions. * **Ownership \& Accountability:** Engineers are trusted to take initiative, drive resolutions, and balance technical decisions with business priorities. * **Continuous Improvement Mindset:** Encourages learning new technologies, refining processes, and adopting best practices to enhance performance and scalability. * **High\-Impact, Fast\-Paced Environment:** Focus on responsiveness, uptime, and delivering reliable infrastructure in a dynamic, mission\-critical setting. *Our Company adheres to the equal employment opportunity guidelines set forth by federal, state and local laws. jobs.title: Quality Engineer (First Shift)
jobs.description: **Hyve Company Overview** ------------------------- Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US\-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co\-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time\-to\-market with single\-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co\-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure. **Hyve Solutions** is a leader in the data center solutions industry, designing, manufacturing, and delivering custom Server, Storage, and Networking Solutions to the world’s largest Cloud, social media, and Enterprise companies. We pride ourselves on collaboration, innovation and thought leadership. Our team consists of diverse, forward\-thinking individuals who dare to challenge the status quo, while working with many of the world’s biggest customers. **Hyve Solutions** is a part of TD SYNNEX Corporation, a Fortune 500 company. Become part of a team that thrives on excellence in a fast\-changing, high\-growth technology environment! **Hyve Solutions** is looking for a detail\-oriented, hands\-on, results\-driven **Quality Engineer** with proven communication skills and a strong work ethic to work in a challenging, fast\-paced, energetic environment. As a **Quality Engineer I**, you will take ownership of key quality control processes, including audits, fall\-out management, and ISO compliance, to ensure products and practices meet company and industry standards. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to resolve quality issues, implement improvements, and support continuous compliance with ISO requirements. This hands\-on role requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and a drive to achieve results in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment. You will report directly to the Quality Manager. **You will** * Review and approve Product and Processes Corrective and Prevention Action Plans. * Assess and evaluate all reliability testing, equipment service and calibration and the verification process. * Perform failure analyses, root cause analysis and corrective action follow\-up. * Execute internal audits on QMS, EMS, ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 standards. * Coordinate UL (Underwriter’s Laboratory) and other regulatory factory audits. * Conduct regular conference calls with customers or vendors and provide reports as needed. * Work with internal Production, Engineering, Shipping/Receiving, Warehouse, Program Managers and Procurement to meet quality standards. * Develop proactive solutions and implement Quality department strategies across the organization. * Perform additional assessment and analysis as assigned. **You have** * BS degree in Computer Science, Electrical, Mechanical or Industrial Engineering or relevant discipline plus 3 years of experience including a combination of 2\+ years in manufacturing, 3\+ years in quality control and 3\+ years in a leadership position or equivalent combination of experience. * Proven understanding of mechanical drawing and/or tools * You should have a good understanding of server level component design and operation, as well as computer system level integration processes and interoperability. * Working knowledge of MS Office programs; Word, Excel and PowerPoint. * Hands\-on experience with quality system training including understanding of SPC (Statistics Process Control) principles and tools. * Established ability prioritizing and managing multiple projects to meet strict deadlines. * Flexibility to work in a fast\-paced, high volume, and diverse environment across functions to produce expected results. * Able to work as business needs require, which may include long days, occasional evenings and weekends, and travel to all manufacturing and warehouse locations, for business meetings or training. **Hyve Perks** Every Day is Casual Day • Company Discounts • Community Involvement Opportunities • Profit Sharing • Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance • 401k • FSA \& HSA • Paid Vacation, Holiday \& Sick Days • Employee Stock Purchase Plan • Tuition Reimbursement • Live Well Work Well Program • And More **What’s in it for you** ------------------------ Benefit Insurance * Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Health Savings Account (HSA) * Mental Health Care * 401K with match * Paid Holidays, Vacation \& Sick Days * Tuition Reimbursement * Perks at Work * LEAP Program * MyFlexPay ***We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
