jobs.title: Sr. Data Scientist
jobs.description: **About Mariana Minerals** ========================== Mariana Minerals is a software\-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data\-driven decision\-making. **The Role** ============ Mariana Minerals is a software\-first, vertically integrated minerals company supplying the minerals critical to modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. Our data doesn't live in a vacuum — it comes off sensors, assays, lab benches, and plant logs, and it's what the business uses to decide what to run, what to buy, what to fix, and what to build next. We're hiring a Senior Data Scientist to be the person who makes those numbers trustworthy and legible. You'll own the statistics: how we measure recovery and throughput, how we know a process change actually worked, how much of a swing is signal and how much is assay noise, and what the reporting layer says when an operator or an executive opens it. This is not an ML modeling role and not a data engineering role. Our MLEs build the models and our data engineers move the data. You bring statistical rigor and clear reporting to a company generating more data than it currently knows how to interpret, and you make sure the conclusions people draw from it are the right ones. **What You'll Do** ================== * Design and analyze plant trials and experiments — DOE, sample sizing, control selection, and the analysis that says whether a process change did what it was supposed to do and at what confidence. * Own the definitions of the metrics the business runs on: recovery, grade, throughput, yield, uptime, unit cost. Decide what each one means, make the definition consistent across teams, and defend it when someone wants to compute it differently. * Build and own the reporting and analytics layer — the recurring reporting, the dashboards, and the self\-serve tooling that lets operators, engineers, and business leads answer their own questions. * Quantify uncertainty honestly: sampling error, assay variability, instrument drift, measurement system analysis. * Apply statistical process control and capability analysis to plant operations — know when a process has actually shifted versus when it's a normal excursion. * Run the deep\-dive analyses that don't have a home: why last month's recovery dropped, what's driving cost variance, which of these three suppliers is actually better, whether this correlation is real. * Do forecasting and estimation for production, cost, and capacity planning — applied statistics that informs commitments, not research models. * Partner with the Technical Product Manager for Data \& Analytics Platform on what the reporting and analytics stack needs next, and be a demanding internal customer of the data platform when the data isn't fit for purpose. * Raise the analytical bar across the company: review other people's analyses, catch the flawed comparison before it reaches a decision meeting, and teach the teams around you enough statistics to stop making the same mistake twice. * Write findings up so they're actually used — a clear memo a non\-statistician can act on, not a notebook that needs you in the room. **How You'll Operate** ====================== * **Rigor with a deadline:** You know the difference between the analysis worth another week and the one that's good enough to decide on today, and you say which is which. * **Skeptical by default:** You ask how the data was collected before you analyze it, and you're the person who notices the sensor was miscalibrated for three weeks. * **Structure from ambiguity:** Turn a vague business question into a well\-posed statistical one, get the data you need, and own the answer end to end. * **Explicit about confidence:** Communicate uncertainty in a way that helps people decide, rather than hedging so heavily the analysis becomes useless. * **Ecosystem fluency:** Understand where your data comes from, what the models and simulators downstream do with it, and where the reporting layer sits relative to the platform underneath it. **What We're Looking For** ========================== **Must have** * 3–6\+ years in data science, statistics, analytics, or a quantitative research role where you owned analyses that drove real decisions * Deep applied statistics: experimental design, hypothesis testing, regression, uncertainty quantification — and the judgment to know which tool fits the question and which assumption you just violated * Strong SQL and Python (pandas, statsmodels, scipy) — enough to get your own data, run your own analysis, and produce your own reporting without waiting on someone else * Track record building reporting and dashboards people actually use, with the product sense to know what belongs on a dashboard versus in a memo * Ability to work with messy, real\-world measurement data — missing values, inconsistent sampling, instrument error — and be clear about what it can and can't support * Exceptional written communication; much of this job is making a technical finding land with operators, engineers, and executives * Comfort being the statistical authority in the room **Nice to have** * Background in mining, metallurgy, chemicals, energy, manufacturing, or other heavy industry — especially metallurgical accounting, mass balance reconciliation, or sampling theory * Experience with statistical process control, or measurement system analysis * Experience with BI and analytics tooling (Hex, Looker, or embedded analytics) and an opinion about how to deploy them * Degree in statistics, chemical engineering, chemistry, operations research, economics, or a related quantitative field * Experience building an analytics function at a company where one didn't exist yet * Working fluency with LLM\-assisted the systems that consume it and relative to the current frontier of LLM capability, so prioritization calls stay well\-calibrated. **What We're Looking For** ========================== **Must have** * 4–8\+ years in technical product management, data platform or analytics product roles, or equivalent experience leading cross\-disciplinary technical programs * Comfortable being the only PM in a highly technical room — you know when to drive a decision, when to defer to engineers, and how to build credibility without being the most technical person there * Enough depth in data infrastructure and analytics to earn credibility with data engineers, data scientists, and analysts, and to know when a technical answer is a good one * Working fluency with the current LLM/foundation\-model ownership of a data platform, warehouse, or analytics stack in production * Experience with BI/analytics tooling strategy (Hex, Looker, or embedded analytics) * Experience shipping LLM\-powered or agentic internal tools * Background in mining, energy, chemicals, manufacturing, or other heavy industry * Experience leading the transition from spreadsheets and scripts to supported software **Why We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to be the single product owner for machine learning and industrial robotics — the ML platform, the simulators it runs, and the perception and robotics initiatives built on it — and to own the seam between our applied AI/ML organization and our software engineering organization. jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (Transit Technology)
jobs.description: At the MBTA, we envision a thriving region enabled by a best\-in\-class transit system. Our mission is to serve the public by providing safe, reliable, and accessible transportation. MBTA’s core values are built around safety, service, equity, sustainability, culture, and accessibility, and each employee that works for the MBTA performs their roles based on our vision, mission, and values. This includes attendance, participation, and contribution in local safety committee meetings as needed. **Job Summary** --------------- The Technical Project Manager for Transit Technology will deploy and implement technology solutions administered by the MBTA’s Transit Technology division or other teams across the Transformation \& Technology Department. The Transit Technology team is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining dispatching systems and other technology tools that enable MBTA Operations division to deliver safer, more efficient, and more reliable transit services. This role will span across the MBTA’s modern civic technology teams (e.g., Software Engineers, Product Managers, UX Research \& Design staff, Application Analysts) and the front\-line operations departments critical for delivering transit service every day. The Technical Project Manager will use their deep technical IT knowledge, expertise at managing vendors, and technical understanding of transit operations processes to drive clarity and organizational change. They will manage and oversee smooth deployments of technical systems and ensure that feedback from operations stakeholders and users are part of technical teams’ iteration and maintenance processes. This role will be able to work successfully across different transit technology teams/topics, and maintain their own roadmap based on priorities set by MBTA leadership. **Duties \& Responsibilities** ------------------------------ * Implement Technology Solutions + Provide rapid\-response project and information technology support during emergencies. + Identify, lead, and support technical initiatives to improve Operations processes and technologies, including but not limited to automation, consolidation, standardization, resiliency planning, and communication with stakeholders. + Define user requirements for system modification, enhancements, and integration. + Develop or work from detailed system and program specifications. + Develop related tracking metrics and reports for Operations. + Develop technical specifications, contract documents, schedules, and budgets. + Manage the preparation of user documentation and train users on application systems. + Prepare and maintain program documentation, including data flow diagrams and program turnover documentation. + Make recommendations for and scope system enhancements. + Work with technology teams to scope or manage technology feature development. + Work with MBTA Procurement to scope, initiate, and administer complex procurements of vendor systems/support while adhering to technology best practices. * Project Management + Develop and manage comprehensive project plans—including scope, goals, budget, timeline, and deliverables—while prioritizing critical path tasks and resource allocation. + Communicate effectively through written and verbal channels, lead productive meetings, and deliver presentations with confidence and minimal oversight. + Provide regular updates on project status, timelines, and key metrics; document process milestones and lead retrospective evaluations to drive continuous improvement. + Identify and mitigate risks and blockers throughout all project phases, escalating issues as needed to maintain momentum. + Guide cross\-functional teams to act with urgency and stay aligned with timelines, roadmaps, and deliverables. + Critically review project documentation to ensure feasibility, mitigate risk, and optimize planning. + Assist with the planning and coordination of overall project management workload and staff deliverables across MBTA Transit Technology teams. * General + Be a committed, vocal, collaborative member of the Transit Technology division and push for excellence in any/all dimensions of its work. + Prepare project\-related correspondence, reports, charts, and presentations. + Work independently in addressing complex tasks in a time\-sensitive environment. + Respond to each inquiry, whether from a customer, vendor, or co\-worker, in a courteous and professional manner consistent with the Authority's Customer Service quality standard. + Visit work sites and/or attend off\-site meetings throughout the MBTA service area. + Perform all other duties and projects that may be assigned. **Additional responsibilities may include a focus on one or more departments or locations. See the applicable addendum for department or location\-specific functions.** **Supervision** * No direct reports. **Minimum Requirements \& Qualifications** ------------------------------------------ * Bachelor’s degree field from an accredi he duration of their program. **Disclaimers and Definitions:** * **General Disclaimer:** The statements contained in this job description are intended to describe a summary, general nature, and complexity of typical job functions and do not represent an exhaustive list of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities required of staff assigned to this position. * **Application Completion:**It is each applicant’s responsibility to ensure application details are entered completely and correctly, including updated work and education histories (past and current). ***Incomplete applications may not be considered.*** Attachments ***do not*** substitute for application fields. Further, all persons hired will require a U.S. Social Security Number prior to starting the position and employees will be required to complete a Form I\-9 to verify their identity and eligibility to work in the U.S. * **Interviews:**Candidates should ensure they arrive on time, are prepared, can remain for the duration, and if remote, are in a quiet place without distraction, for the interview. jobs.description: Essential Duties and Responsibilities:* Responsible for the computer systems analysis, requirements analysis, modeling, configuration, monitoring and support for mission\-critical applications. * Lead the monitoring and testing of application performance for potential bottlenecks, identify possible solutions, and work with developers to implement those fixes. * Work closely with business and systems analysts to define system requirements to meet both internal and external customer needs. * Provide status updates to manager, and project manager on project progress, This role is responsible for defining and executing Micron's vision across enterprise networks, cloud platforms, data center strategy, database services, infrastructure engineering, automation, observability, and global infrastructure operations. As a key member of the TE\&I leadership team, you will drive innovation, operational excellence, and strategic transformation while building a high\-performing organization focused on business outcomes and exceptional customer experiences. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable developing multi\-year technology strategies, leading large\-scale infrastructure transformations, driving operational performance, developing talent, and fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. **What You Will Do** **Lead Global Infrastructure Strategy \& Transformation** * Define and execute Micron's global infrastructure vision and strategy. * Develop multi\-year roadmaps for: + Enterprise Network Services + Network Architecture + Data Center Strategy and Modernization + Cloud Platforms and Engineering + Database Services and Engineering + Infrastructure Automation + Platform Engineering + Observability and Monitoring + Reliability and Resilience Engineering + Global Network Operations Center (GNOC) * Drive large\-scale modernization initiatives focused on: + Cloud transformation + Infrastructure simplification + AI\-enabled operations + Service resiliency + Automation at scale + Cost optimization + Technical debt reduction * Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on infrastructure investments, risk management, emerging technologies, and innovation opportunities. **Drive Engineering Excellence** * Lead global engineering organizations responsible for network, cloud, database, and infrastructure platforms. * Establish modern engineering standards and practices, including: + Infrastructure as Code + Platform Engineering + Service Reliability Engineering (SRE) + DevOps and Automation + Architecture Governance + AI\-assisted Engineering * Create scalable, secure, and resilient technology platforms that accelerate business outcomes and operational effectiveness. * Champion engineering excellence through innovation, standardization, and continuous improvement. **Deliver World\-Class Operations** * Own the health, performance, availability, and reliability of Micron's global infrastructure environment. * Lead and evolve the Global Network Operations Center (GNOC) to deliver proactive, predictive, and highly efficient operations. * Establish operational excellence programs with a focus on: + Service reliability + Availability + Performance + Customer satisfaction + Automation + Operational maturity + Cost efficiency * Drive improvements in service delivery through data\-driven decision making, observability, and continuous service improvement. **Accelerate Innovation** * Identify and operationalize emerging technologies that create measurable business value. * Drive innovation in: + AI for Operations (AIOps) + Intelligent Automation + Cloud\-Native Services + Software\-Defined Infrastructure + Infrastructure Intelligence Platforms + Predictive Analytics + Autonomous Operations * Foster a culture that embraces experimentation, continuous learning, and responsible innovation. **Build Culture, Talent \& Organizational Capability** * Build and lead a high\-performing global organization across engineering and operations disciplines. * Create a culture centered on: + Accountability + Ownership + Innovation + Speed of Execution + Operational Excellence + Collaboration + Inclusion + Continuous Learning * Develop future leaders through coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and leadership development. * Establish clear goals, measurable outcomes, and strong performance management practices. * Build an engaged organization where employees are empowered to challenge the status quo, solve complex problems, and continuously improve how work gets done. * Promote a growth mindset that encourages learning, experimentation, and adoption of modern technologies and AI\-driven capabilities. **Foster Enterprise Collaboration \& Partnerships** * Build trus y. * Developing talent and future leaders. * Leading through influence and collaboration. * Creating clarity during periods of transformation. * Delivering measurable business outcomes. * Challenging the status quo and embracing innovation. * Making data\-driven decisions. * Operating with integrity, transparency, and accountability. **Success in This Role** Success will be measured through: * Improved jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer & Cloud Lead
jobs.description: **Job Summary** Mighty Oak Medical is seeking a Senior Software Engineer \& Cloud Lead to support the development and ongoing operation of our medical device software platforms. This is a broad technical role combining hands\-on software engineering, cloud infrastructure, and technical project leadership. The successful candidate will work closely with engineering and software teams while leading new product developments. The position offers significant ownership across the software lifecycle—from requirements and architecture through development, testing, deployment, and maintenance. We are looking for someone with a strong computer science or software engineering foundation who is comfortable moving between hands\-on technical work and project leadership. This role will also support our AWS infrastructure, cloud\-based applications, and internal software and IT systems. **Responsibilities** \- Manage software development projects from requirements and technical planning through implementation, testing, release, and maintenance. \- Coordinate software development to ensure projects are appropriately scoped, prioritized, documented, and completed on schedule. \- Serve as a technical owner for company software platforms, including desktop applications, cloud\-based web applications, databases, APIs, and supporting infrastructure. \- Manage and support AWS cloud infrastructure, including application deployment, configuration, monitoring, security, and maintenance. \- Contribute directly to software development through new functionality, maintenance of existing applications, scripting, automation, and development of internal tools. \- Review software architecture, designs, code, and technical solutions developed by internal and external development teams. \- Organize, scope, and prioritize software feature backlogs in collaboration with Engineering, Product Development, Quality, Regulatory, and commercial stakeholders. \- Translate product, clinical, and business needs into clear software requirements and actionable technical development tasks. \- Diagnose software issues, investigate root causes, and implement or coordinate corrective solutions. \- Identify opportunities to improve software performance, reliability, security, maintainability, and development processes. \- Develop and maintain software lifecycle documentation, including requirements, specifications, risk analyses, verification and validation documentation, and release records. \- Support software verification and validation activities for regulated medical device software. \- Participate in software risk management, cybersecurity, and FMEA activities. \- Communicate directly with customers, vendors, development partners, and other external stakeholders on technical topics as needed. \- Provide technical support for internal IT systems and assist with software, hardware, networking, and cloud\-related issues. \- Collaborate closely with Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, Operations, Sales, and Marketing teams. **Skills** \-Strong foundation in computer science, software engineering principles, data structures, and application architecture. \-Experience with software design, development, debugging, testing, and maintenance. \-Ability to understand, troubleshoot, review, and contribute to an existing software codebase. \-Experience managing software projects or coordinating work across multiple developers or development partners. \-Ability to translate business and product requirements into technical requirements and actionable development tasks. \-Experience with cloud\-based software systems and infrastructure. \-Understanding of modern web application architecture, including frontend/backend systems, REST APIs, databases, authentication, and cloud services. \-Experience with Git or comparable source\-control systems and collaborative software development workflows. \-Familiarity with modern software build, testing, deployment, and release practices, including CI/CD. \-Familiarity with containerized applications and technologies such as Docker is preferred. \-Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. \-Strong written and verbal technical communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to non\-software stakeholders. \-Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a small, fast\-moving organization. **Education and Experience** \-Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline. \-3\+ years of professional software development, software engineering, or related experience preferred. Candidates with less experience and a strong technical background may also be considered. \-Experience with Python and SQL strongly preferred. \-Experience with AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure strongly preferred. \-Experience developing or supporting cloud\-based web applications preferred. \-Experience with APIs, databases, authentication, and modern web application architectures preferred. \-Experience with Git, CI/CD workflows, automated testing, and software deployment preferred. \-Experience with Docker or other container technologies is a plus. \-Experience coordinating software development teams preferred. \-Experience in the medical device, healthcare software, or another regulated industry is beneficial but not required. \-Familiarity with FDA medical device software expectations, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, cybersecurity, software risk management, and software validation is a plus. **Ideal Candidate** This position is not exclusively a coding role. The successful candidate will have enough technical depth to understand how complex software systems work, contribute directly when needed, evaluate technical decisions, troubleshoot problems, and communicate effectively with both software developers and non\-software stakeholders. We are looking for someone who can take technical ownership of software development while effectively managing multiple projects. The ideal candidate can evaluate proposed architectures and technical solutions, ask the right questions, identify potential problems, and help ensure that development decisions support both immediate product needs and the long\-term maintainability of our software. We are particularly interested in someone who enjoys working at the intersection of software engineering, cloud technology, technical project leadership, and product development. Because Mighty Oak is a small and growing organization, this position provides an opportunity to take meaningful ownership of software products and see projects through from early concepts to software used in real\-world surgical planning. Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $95,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Ability to Relocate: * Englewood, CO 80110: Relocate before starting work (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: MANAGER II - CONSTRUCTION
jobs.description: **Job Summary** --------------- Milwaukee Public Schools is actively recruiting qualified candidates for the Manager II \- Construction position. The Manager II \- Construction position plans, directs, coordinates and supervises construction related activities; including the construction project management team for the Capital Planning and Construction Group for the Department of Facilities and Maintenance Services and is responsible for project management and construction administration on all major building renovations, additions, or new building projects; oversees and manages the performance of prime contractors, MPS trades personnel, and architects/engineers during the construction phase of major projects; supervises trades personnel as assigned to oversee and inspect major projects; represents the Department of Facilities and Maintenance Services with respect to design, construction, and building code related issues. Applications for Manager II \- Construction are being accepted by the Office of Human Resources through Tuesday, October 6, 2026\. All applicants must upload the following items to the application: * A current resume * Transcripts confirming the required bachelor's degree (unofficial transcripts can be submitted, however official transcripts will be required upon hire). If you are unable to electronically attach these documents, please email them to Cassandra Morales\-Salcedo at morac2@milwaukeepublicschools.org The wage range is $114,000 \- $124,000 (12\-month position) **How To Apply** ---------------- Interested applicants should complete all sections of the application including the online submission of a current resume and transcripts confirming the required bachelor's degree (unofficial transcripts can be submitted, however official transcripts will be required upon hire). Qualified applicants will be sent a notice to submit one electronic professional reference using our software, VidCruiter. The notice will be sent via email from careers@milwaukeepublicschool.org. Applications for Manager II \- Construction are being accepted by the Office of Human Resources through Tuesday, October 6, 2026\. No applications or application materials will be accepted after the deadline date. Appointment is subject to a criminal background check, a drug/alcohol test and credential verification. If you have any questions, please contact Cassandra Morales\-Salcedo at morac2@milwaukeepublicschools.org or 414\-777\-7879\. **Qualifications** ------------------ Eligible applicants MUST meet the following: **Education Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, architecture, business management, or a related field from an accredited college. **Experience Requirements: ; ;** * Recent project manager experience on individual projects in excess of $15 million required. * Minimum of seven years of experience in building construction or construction related activity. **License and Certification Requirements:** * Valid State of Wisconsin motor vehicle operator's license and availability of a properly insured personal vehicle at time of appointment and during employment. * *An equivalent combination of relevant education and construction management experience may be substituted in lieu of a degree.* **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Oversee, coordinate and evaluate the activities of the project management group; consisting of the Construction Project Managers and related contracted service providers. * Develop project processes and standard operating procedures and ensure they are followed by the project management group, contractors and other contracted services. * Coordinate construction activities with other district initiatives and programs. * Coordinate, monitor and approve project schedules, design requirements, constructability assessments, project funding, bid schedules, project management resources, inspection oversight, payment applications for all project work associated with major projects administered through the Department of Facilities and Maintenance Services. * Provide oversight and direction on the scope development and bidding of requests for proposals (RFPs) for design and Construction Bids. * Prepare progress reports and formal cost estimate and provide information as requested. * Monitor safe work practices of outside contractors. * Oversee and project manage construction administration activities on major building renovations, additions, new construction, and major capital maintenance projects worth up to $35M annually. Assist in the development of project budgets. Monitor contractor performance to ensure that work is completed by qualified personnel according to contract documents. Provide inspection reports and represent MPS at construction project/progress meetings. Maintain all project files. Administer construction project budgets. Oversee and manage the services of construction managers, MPS construction and shop/trade inspectors, architects/engineers, and contracted inspectors. Conduct pre\-bid and pre\-construction meetings and provide minutes of same. * Work directly with architects and engineers directly in the development of design and construction documents. Review contract documents prior to bidding for adherence to scope, MPS requirements, and project budget. Identify inconsistencies in documents and assist in value engineering. Provide design services and activities associated with smaller projects as required. * Review and approve change orders and monthly payment requests. Generate written communications as necessary to project participants. Review and assist in updating the MPS Guide Specifications. Miscellaneous office work including copying, filing, and similar. * Work with outside agencies and public officials as necessary to evaluate problems or develop ideas in support of potential projects and MPS district initiatives. * Actively support the MPS Strategic Plan. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Other Information** --------------------- **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** * Working knowledge and skills of construction documents including AIA and CSI documents. * Working knowledge with computers including word processing, Excel, and Microsoft projects. * Experience in writing technical reports as well as general correspondence. * Ability to evaluate various design and construction methods as well as develop and/or validate construction schedules. * Ability to evaluate and make decisions on various designs as well as construction means and methods based on technical data, material performance/selection, and constructability constraints. * Experience in and ability to develop cost estimates. **Working Environment:** **;** * Combination of office and field environment. * Will be exposed to dirty and dusty conditions as part of field work. **Physical Demands:** * Must be able to climb and work at various heights and in hazardous environments. **Equal Employment Opportunity** -------------------------------- The Milwaukee Public Schools does not discriminate in its programs, activities, facilities, employment, or educational opportunities on the basis of a person's sex, race, age, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, creed, pregnancy, marital or parental status, sexual orientation, or disability. Reasonable accommodations requested by qualified individuals with disabilities will be made in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, as amended by the Americans with Disabilities Act Amendments Act (ADAAA) of 2008\. In accordance with Wisconsin Statutes, every applicant for a position with Milwaukee Public Schools will be subject to the open records law. ; Any applicant not wishing to have his/her identity released, must submit a written statement to that effect to the Office of Human Resources. ; The identities of all "final candidates" may be released. ; Milwaukee Public Schools reserves the right to interview the best qualified candidates. **Pay, Benefits, \& Work Schedule** ----------------------------------- The wage range is $114,000 \- $124,000 (12\-month position)

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer II - Operations
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Excited to grow your career? We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply! Our people make all the difference in our success. ***Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.; Sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.*** At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to drive disruptive new technologies and solutions across our operations teams. Our Operations Teams are responsible for the manufacturing, service, supply chain, and quality systems that bring our products to life and into the hands of our users. We continue to invest in advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI capabilities to transform how we run our plants, optimize production, and anticipate issues before they reach the line. We’re pushing the limits in data engineering, deep learning, and generative AI applied to real\-world manufacturing problems. **Your role on our team:** As a Machine Learning Engineer II, you will design, develop, and deploy machine learning solutions that improve how Milwaukee Tool manufactures and services products. Working cross\-functionally with operations, quality, supply chain, engineering, and service teams, you will develop and implement data\-driven solutions that address real\-world business and operational challenges globally. You will contribute to the full machine learning lifecycle, from data engineering and model development to deployment and monitoring on Azure and Databricks. A key aspect of this role is partnering with our Global and Service Teams to deploy, validate, and support machine learning solutions in operational environments, ensuring models deliver measurable value where they are used. This role is ideal for a self\-motivated engineer who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, communicates effectively across technical and non\-technical teams, and takes ownership of delivering impactful, production\-ready solutions. **What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:** * Bachelor of Science Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or other scientific or engineering discipline. * Completed course work or specialization in Machine Learning and/or Data Science using one or more deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, etc). * At least one year of hands\-on experience applying machine learning principles and algorithms to dynamic, real\-world problems. * Demonstrated experience applying fundamental machine learning algorithms and techniques in a non\-coursework setting (e.g. unsupervised or supervised learning, classification/regression, dimensionality reduction, model optimization). * Demonstrated experience with machine learning and AI methods such as CNNs, transformers, or computer vision. * Proficiency in big data transformation using Spark, SQL, and Python (NumPy, pandas, scikit\-learn, Matplotlib). * Sold mathematical foundation in statistics, linear algebra, calculus and optimization. * Experience working with ML deployments using CI/CD pipelines (Azure, Databricks, MLFlow) and edge devices (GPU, Containerization, Linux). * Excellent problem\-solving and technical communication skills translating complex ML deployments into language that non\-technical audience can understand. * Experience collaborating with global teams, including a willingness to adjust working hours to accommodate international time zones and ensure project alignment. Ability to travel up to 20% of the time (domestic and international). * **Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:** * Master’s degree or PhD in Machine Learning or related field is preferred. * At least three years of hands\-on experience applying machine learning principles and algorithms to dynamic, real\-world problems. * Experience with time\-series modeling for use cases such as demand forecasting, predictive maintenance, yield prediction, or process anomaly detection. * Experience with computer vision for use cases such as defect detection, missing part detection, part quality inspection, part counting, etc. * Proven track record of developing, deploying, and scaling AI or ML solutions tied to measurable operations outcomes (e.g. scrap reduction, throughput, OEE, on\-time delivery, inventory turns). * Desktop application or Web app development experience (e.g. building tools or UIs that put models in the hands of plant and operations users). * Hands\-on data engineering experience building pipelines on Databricks/Spark against large operational datasets (MES, ERP, SCADA, IoT/Sensor Telemetry). * Experience applying generative AI or LLMs to operations problems such as knowledge retrieval, document processing, or assistive tooling for plant teams. * Experience in developing, maintaining and using MLOps pipelines and ensure efficient deployment, monitoring, and scaling of ML models in production. Experience developing and deploying machine learning algorithms to edge environments. * **We provide these great perks and benefits:** * Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans. * Generous 401 (K) savings plan. * Education assistance. * On\-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service. And many more, check out our benefits site HERE . * *Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.*

jobs.title: Senior Staff Performance Engineer, Firefox
jobs.description: **Why Mozilla?** Mozilla Corporation is the non\-profit\-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy\-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non\-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute **open\-source** software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. **About this team and role:** The Mozilla Firefox Performance team is a community of engineers who care deeply about delivering the fastest browser possible. We are the team responsible for making all parts of the browser go fast. Our team is geographically\-distributed, and working in the open is the norm. We contribute to the code driving the Firefox browser on a number of platforms \- Windows, Android, Linux, and macOS. Our focus is on finding and fixing things that slow down the browser as well as helping other teams write fast and reliable code to make Firefox excellent for users. Do you value curiosity and enjoy finding a needle in a haystack? Do you approach problems by looking at the system as a whole? Do you want to help lead and shape the future of the Internet? Do you like making things blazingly fast? If so, we’d love to hear from you. **What you'll do:** * Write code and tests, build prototypes, tackle problems, profile and analyze performance bottlenecks * Learn about a wide variety of problems and solutions across a large, complex, and evolving codebase * Use several programming languages (e.g., C\+\+, JavaScript, Kotlin, Rust, Python) and techniques to fix performance issues, with an emphasis on C\+\+ and JavaScript * Help to educate engineers on other teams about writing more performant code through code reviews, giving talks, implementing tooling, and/or writing documentation * Independently define and drive actionable next steps from high level objectives * Work with engineering teams across the organization to assist and lead performance efforts * Shape the future of performance benchmarks, and set the proper priorities for the necessary improvements * Develop strategies for the future of the Performance team and the Organization as a whole * Work with driven, committed team members to help bring the Open Web to millions of people **What you'll bring:** * BS/MS in CS, CE and 7\+ years relevant experience * A mastered understanding of programming in C\+\+ * An understanding of programming in JavaScript * You have proven experience developing performance critical software * You take an experimental and measured approach to solving problems (measurement, and using experiments to diagnose an issue or prove out a solution) * Proven skill in debugging and analyzing performance bottlenecks, and using profiling tools to diagnose and fix issues (VTune, Xperf, other sampling based profilers) * Experience with multithreading and concurrency, disk I/O, GPU * Proven track record of setting team goals and driving them to completion. * Experience motivating and aligning cross\-functional teams to deliver on shared goals. * An interest and ability to work in a distributed team (which requires good asynchronous written communication skills as jobs.title: Lead, Software Application
jobs.description: **Who we are** Neros is a defense technology company rebuilding America's drone industrial base. We design and manufacture high\-performance unmanned systems that are tested in combat, iterated at startup speed, and built at massive scale. Our team culture is fast, hands\-on, and obsessed with closing the gap between design and deployment. As drones transform the character of warfare, Neros is delivering the systems the West needs to compete on the modern battlefield and deter the adversaries of democracy. We're hiring engineers, operators, and builders who want to move fast, take on extreme ownership, and get capability into the hands of warfighters in months, not years. **What you will be doing** Neros builds first\-person\-view drones for the modern battlefield. As a Lead, Software Application Engineer, you will own the development of applications — the web, desktop, and Android tools and backend services our operators and engineers use to plan missions, configure the system, and record and analyze flight data. You will own the development, quality, and delivery across both, and grow the team behind them. **Responsibilities** * Lead and grow the team across application and backend development — hiring, mentorship, and performance management * Own application development end to end using modern cross\-platform stacks spanning Windows, Linux, macOS, and web * Own the backend behind them — services and APIs, data pipelines into our analytics datalake, identity and tenancy, and software update * Build for offline: our tools run with or without a connection to the backend, and offline is a normal operating state rather than a failure to handle * Make the hard architecture calls — front\-end architecture, build vs. adopt, data model, tenancy and security, local vs. backend state * Set and uphold engineering and operational quality — code review, testing, CI/CD, observability, on\-call * Stay hands\-on: review code and own architecture, not just process **You should have the following** * Has led a software team as a hands\-on manager — owning both people management and technical direction * Strong background in application development (modern web and cross\-platform desktop) and the backend behind it (services, APIs, data, identity, CI/CD, observability) — you can lead and review across both * Experience building applications that work offline — local\-first state, syncing when a connection returns, and staying fully usable while disconnected * Strong judgment on application architecture, build vs. adopt, data modeling, and security trade\-offs * Able to operate as the interface between the team and leadership — managing expectations upward and clearing blockers * Player\-coach: still writes code and reviews PRs, and is technically credible enough to own architecture across front\-end, service, and data **Nice to Have** * Cross\-platform desktop delivery (Electron or similar) shipped to real users * Android development, particularly device\-facing or field\-tool applications * Defense, industrial, robotics, or field\-deployed apps and backends * Data\-pipeline and analytics depth — streaming, time\-series, telemetry at scale * Identity/access/tenancy for multi\-customer or multi\-tenant systems * Experience building a team spanning app and backend development from a small nucleus **US Salary Range** $198,000 \- $277,000 USD jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary:** The Controls Engineer independently owns controls workstreams end\-to\-end with general direction. This role designs, validates, and delivers PLC, HMI/SCADA, instrumentation, and controls hardware solutions that meet performance, safety, reliability, and integration requirements. The Controls Engineer makes independent design decisions within assigned scope, contributes to controls standards, and supports deployment and commissioning of linear accelerator and related industrial control systems. This is a full\-time, onsite position at Nusano's facility in Valencia, CA. **Responsibilities:** * Own the design, specification, schematic capture, programming, installation, qualification, and commissioning of assigned controls workstreams for linear accelerator and supporting industrial systems. * Design and support electrical control cabinets, instrumentation, power supplies, network devices, and related controls hardware in accordance with applicable requirements. * Lead troubleshooting of PLCs, network devices, instrumentation, controls hardware, and hardware/software interfaces during build, test, integration, and operations. * Analyze electrical, data communication, and dynamic systems; conduct trade studies and recommend solutions based on performance, safety, reliability, schedule, and cost. * Develop prototypes and proof\-of\-concept solutions for new controls hardware or system requirements. * Participate in hazard analyses and design reviews and apply controls safety best practices. * Develop test plans, commissioning procedures, operating procedures, system architecture documentation, and maintainable engineering records. * Coordinate with mechanical engineering, physics, operations, safety, software, and vendors to deliver integrated controls solutions. * Mentor Associate engineers on tools, standards, and design practices and raise risks or blockers early with clear technical context. **Minimum Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related technical field. * Practical, hands\-on experience building, testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning industrial control systems. * Experience with HMI/SCADA systems, industrial networks, instrumentation, and control panels. * Experience reading and developing electrical schematics, one\-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, and P\&IDs using tools such as SOLIDWORKS Electrical or AutoCAD Electrical. * Knowledge of industrial controls and electrical safety standards, such as UL 508A, NFPA 79, ISA, and IEC standards. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical decisions and tradeoffs to cross\-functional partners. **Preferred Experience:** * EPICS, Beckhoff controls, or other distributed control systems. * High\-speed electronics, high\-vacuum systems, accelerator operations, or high\-voltage equipment. * Working in an R\&D, commissioning, or safety\-controlled environment. * Selecting and qualifying controls components and working with external vendors. sources. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Nutrient** ================== At Nutrient, we're revolutionizing how the world works with documents. Our tools transform static files into intelligent, secure workflows, empowering businesses to innovate faster and smarter. Trusted by thousands of organizations across 80 countries, including Fortune 500 companies and public sector leaders, our platform supports nearly a billion end users globally in industries where documents aren't just files, they're mission\-critical. **Your Role at Nutrient...** ============================ As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) on our Sales team, your work starts with a customer: * You will find the document problem that is actually costing them money, and build the working solution yourself, on their documents, that works with or within their environment, against a scorecard we agree on before we start. * Then you will turn what you built into something the next customer can buy ready made. We commit to the specific outcome for the customer, and we then measure how much of each engagement converts into actual product. Here’s how this role is different: * If you are a **solutions engineer** today, the difference is that you ship. * If you are a **professional services engineer** today, the difference is that the work is not billed by the hour against a spec someone else wrote, and success is not a signed\-off SOW but a customer outcome and a reusable capability in the product. * If you are a **product engineer** today, the difference is that your users are in the room, on the call, and occasionally disagreeing with you. This is a role for someone who is genuinely comfortable in all three chairs: the discovery conversation where you work out what job the customer is actually trying to get done, the terminal where you build it by Friday, and the seat at the table when the product is being meaningfully developed. **What You'll Work On...** ========================== * **Discover the problem before anyone scopes it**. Get into the customer's process deeply enough to state the job to be done in their words. Most engagements start because someone asked for a feature; the work is finding the outcome behind the request. * **Build the first implementation yourself**. Working software on the customer's own documents and in their own environment if necessary, fast enough that the demo lands while the problem is still urgent. A prototype that shows beats a deck that tells, and a working solution closes the deal. * **Agree a scorecard upfront and hit it.** Every engagement starts with a written definition of what success looks like and how it will be measured. We commit to that result. * **Stitch across the whole platform**. Real solutions cut across Nutrient Workflow, Document Engine, our Document Web Services APIs, the Web and native SDKs, AI data extraction, and whatever the customer already runs. Recent engagements have meant SharePoint and Salesforce integrations, AWS Bedrock models, .NET services behind consistent\-hash routing, bulk export pipelines, and database archiving. * **Productize what you build**. Choose the implementation that makes the next customer easier, not the one that closes fastest. In a recent engagement we deliberately built a cover\-sheet generator on AI Data Extraction rather than a SQL script, and that task is now stronger for every customer. Several deliverables from that engagement are now licensable product components and self\-service features. * **Close the loop back into the company**. Write up what you learned, file the defects you hit, articulate the pattern so the next engagement starts from it, and hand the template to the next team. Forward deployed work that stays inside one account is just consulting. * **Support the deal**. You will work alongside account executives and solutions engineers before the contract as well as after it. What you build during the sales cycle is often what decides whether we win. **What You'll Bring...** ======================== The shortest description of the profile: a strong software engineer who has moved toward product thinking — you care about the problem, not the ticket — and who is unusually good with customers. You live in a world that exists beyond technical requirements and can quickly go into solution mode to deliver a working solution. You are likely a good fit if most of the following are true:* You can run a discovery conversation. You ask about the business process before the API, and you can tell the difference between a use case and a job to be done. * You get real leverage out of coding agents. Our customers expect the first working version in days, not sprints, and that only happens if you direct agents well. * You have shipped production software for years, and you still build. You are comfortable being the only engineer on a problem and being a part of a team that delivers the solution. * You are fluent in at least one of JavaScript or TypeScript, .NET/C\#, Java, Python or Go, and you p  experience** with the systems enterprises actually run, such as SharePoint, Salesforce, Power Automate, or an internal system nobody has documented since 2011\. * Comfort working with **regulated environments** and the conversations that come with them, such as HIPAA, FedRAMP, FIPS, and government cloud. Be honest with yourself — this is probably not for you if:* You want a clean backlog and a quiet quarter. Early engagements will be ambiguous and the team's boundaries with Engineering and Professional Services are still being drawn. * You prefer to hand off after the design. Here you build it. * You would rather build the perfect bespoke thing than the slightly less perfect thing three more customers can use. **Also…** ========= * **Your first 90 days**: By day 30 you will have shadowed two live engagements and shipped one small thing a customer uses. By day 60 you will own an engagement end to end, from discovery through the agreed scorecard. By day 90 at least one thing you built will be on its way into the product as a template or a component, and you will have written up why. * **How we will measure your impact**: Customer outcomes against the scorecards you agreed, revenue influenced through the engagements you run, and the share of your work that converts into reusable product rather than staying in one account. That last one is the number that keeps Nutrient a software company. * **Team and location**: You will join the Forward Deployed Engineering team, reporting into Sales, working daily with Engineering and the Account teams. We are hiring in Raleigh, NC and in London. Expect meaningful travel to customer sites, concentrated in bursts around engagement kickoffs. **Who Thrives Here...** ======================= At Nutrient, we’re not just hiring for skills — we’re hiring for mindset. The people who thrive here are: * **Collaborators**: You collaborate openly, listen actively, and prioritize team success over ego. * **Hungry Learners**: Rapid learning fuels progress and career growth. * **Curious Thinkers**: You dig deep to uncover the “why,” valuing understanding over simply being right. * **Self\-Starters**: You take action without waiting for direction, turning obstacles into opportunities with creativity and persistence. * **Owners**: You take responsibility for solutions and outcomes, always looking for ways to improve what’s within your control. * **Doers**: You’re energized by progress, motivated to create meaningful impact, and eager to tackle challenges. **Why You'll Love Working Here...** =================================== At Nutrient, we build tools that reshape how businesses and developers work with documents. Our culture is centered on continuous growth and collaboration. Every team member has room to learn, innovate, and drive meaningful impact. * **Real technical ownership:** you're not just managing relationships; you're running technical discovery, building POCs, and being the engineer in the room for your customers. * **Cross\-functional influence:** your work sits at the intersection of CS, Solutions Architecture, and Support, with a direct line to shape product direction through customer advocacy. * **Distributed and async\-first:** minimal meetings, strong writing culture, and the independence to manage your own work. * **Mission\-critical product:** Nutrient's platform is trusted by 15%\+ of the Global 500 across 80\+ countries. * **Strong growth trajectory:** ARR grown from $28M to $49M over the past two years, backed by Insight Partners. Nutrient believes in equal opportunity. We employ people from many cultures and countries, celebrate diversity, and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, skill sets, and perspectives. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, marital status, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other non\-merit factor.

Our services put technology to work for our customers so that they can devote all their energies to their core mission.With our strong pool of talented, expert staff, Nuvitek has a sterling track record of providing innovative and reliable IT solutions in the area of IT modernization, cloud integration, infrastructure automation, IT operations, IT service management and data integration to both government and commercial clients. jobs.title: Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Implements and optimizes components within existing distributed systems under guidance. Applies basic scalability requirements, conducts performance/load testing, and configures resiliency features (retries, circuit breakers, timeouts) to handle network variability. Builds telemetry, alerts, and runbook\-driven procedures; delivers scoped features and fault\-injection tests; and helps implement basic data replication and synchronization. Assists with on\-call rotations, uses automation/IaC scripts to troubleshoot, and follows change, security, and compliance procedures (encryption, access controls, remediation plans) while escalating complex issues to senior engineers. **Responsibilities** As a Core Infrastructure Software Engineer, you will: * Design, develop, and operate highly available, scalable, and fault\-tolerant microservices across control plane, connectivity, distributed\-systems data plane, and Linux daemon technologies. * Contribute throughout the product lifecycle, from conceptualization and product definition through design, development, launch, and operational maturity. * Identify opportunities to automate engineering workflows across development, testing, troubleshooting, operations, and documentation, leveraging AI\-assisted and agentic approaches where appropriate. * Measure and improve reliability, delivery velocity, operational efficiency, customer outcomes, and engineering productivity, while sharing effective practices across the team. * You should be a hands\-on, adaptable, and self\-motivated engineer who learns quickly, applies new tools thoughtfully, and enjoys solving challenging high\-availability and scalability problems. **Qualifications** * 3\+ years of experience with systems or application development. * 3\+ years of experience with distributed systems or backend development. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related engineering field. * Proficiency with data structures, algorithms, and operating systems. * Experience with distributed systems, including familiarity with CAP theorem, consensus, messaging, and high availability. * Demonstrated willingness to learn and responsibly apply AI/LLM tools, skills, and automation to improve engineering workflows.

jobs.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Networking is the foundation that enables customers to run mission\-critical workloads at global cloud scale. We're rearchitecting OCI's routing foundation from the ground up to support the next generation of networking services. This is a unique opportunity to influence the architecture of one of the world's largest cloud networking platforms. We're looking for engineers with strong computer science fundamentals, a deep understanding of networking and routing, and a passion for building large\-scale distributed systems to join our technical leadership team. Our team develops the core infrastructure that powers OCI Networking's data plane, solving complex challenges in routing, workload placement, and fleet management at cloud scale. You'll collaborate across OCI Networking and Infrastructure teams to shape the future of OCI Networking. Key Responsibilities System Design \& Architecture \- System Scalability: –Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools. –Optimize code and/or systems for large\-scale data processing and high\-throughput requirements to support hyper\-scale systems. –Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met. –Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down). –Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large\-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. –Design performance and load testing. System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Design: –Build and design fault\-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in\-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. –Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. –Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load\-shedding, throttling, and rate\-limiting. –Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department. System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Performance: –Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems. –Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health.. System Design \& Architecture \- Correctness / Availability: –Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems. –Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault\-injection, brown\-out) to evaluate system correctness. –Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. Operational Troubleshooting \& Incident Management: –Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes. –Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. –Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance. –Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation. –Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations. Compliance \& Security: –Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi\-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls. –Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps. –Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date. Automation \& Change Management: –Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. –Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes. Core Responsibilities Planning \& Execution: –Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately\-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines. Collaboration \& Partnership: –Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. Problem Solving: –Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies. Continuous Learning: –Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams. Continuous Improvement: –Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement. Performance and Development: –Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Platform - Nashville
jobs.description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) delivers mission\-critical applications for leading enterprises worldwide. Our cloud offers hyperscale, multi\-tenant services deployed across more than 50 regions globally. OCI continues to expand beyond traditional public\-cloud boundaries to support dedicated, hybrid, and multicloud solutions, edge computing, and more. As a Principal Platform Software Engineer, you will shape the platform foundations that allow OCI services and their consumers to work together reliably at scale. You will lead cross\-team initiatives involving APIs, middleware, runtimes, integration frameworks, and developer tooling—setting technical direction while delivering durable solutions that improve consistency, compatibility, and developer experience. **This position is office\-based and requires onsite presence in Nashville, Tennessee. Relocation assistance may be available in accordance with Oracle's relocation policies.** **What You'll Do** * Lead the design, development, and evolution of backend platform services, APIs, middleware, runtimes, and integration frameworks used across OCI. * Define and drive API versioning, lifecycle, deprecation, and safe\-rollout strategies that protect downstream consumers. * Establish reusable patterns for interoperability, multi\-tenant scale, resilience, and secure software development across multiple services. * Drive shared observability practices, including service\-level objectives, error budgets, monitoring, and capacity planning. * Diagnose and resolve complex cross\-service issues; lead durable remediation and compatibility\-safe migration plans. * Influence architecture and technical decisions across teams through design reviews, code reviews, technical guidance, and hands\-on engineering. * Create migration guides, adoption playbooks, documentation, and examples that make platform capabilities straightforward to adopt. Mentor engineers and raise the quality of designs, code, operational practices, and technical decision\-making across the organization. * **What You'll Bring** * Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 7\+ years of professional software\-engineering experience, with demonstrated impact on backend, platform, or cloud services. * Strong experience designing highly available, scalable distributed systems and evolving production APIs or platform interfaces. * Proficiency in one or more object\-oriented or systems programming languages, such as Java, C\+\+, C\#, or Go. * Deep understanding of distributed\-systems fundamentals, object\-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and secure software\-development practices. * Demonstrated experience leading or influencing architecture and technical design across teams. * Strong judgment in ambiguous environments, a high degree of ownership, and clear written and verbal communication skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with microservices, SDKs, RESTful APIs, containers, cloud\-native deployments, or developer\-platform products. * Experience defining or operating SLOs, error budgets, observability standards, and capacity plans. * Experience with API interoperability, backward compatibility, migrations, or platform\-adoption programs. * Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices across multiple teams

jobs.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: We're looking for hands\-on engineers with expertise and passion in solving difficult problems in distributed systems, virtualized infrastructure, and highly available services. If this is you, at Oracle you can design and build innovative new systems from the ground up. These are exciting times in our space \- we are growing fast, still at an early stage, and working on ambitious new initiatives. An engineer at any level can have a significant technical and business impact. As a member of the software engineering division, you will take an active role in defining and evolving standard practices and procedures. You will be responsible for defining and developing software for tasks associated with the developing, designing, and debugging software applications or operating systems. At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we build the future of the cloud for Enterprises as a diverse team of fellow creators and inventors. We act with the speed and attitude of a start\-up, with the scale and customer focus of the leading enterprise software company in the world. Values are OCI's foundation and how we deliver excellence. We strive for equity, inclusion, and respect for all. We are committed to the greater good in our products and our actions. We are constantly learning and taking opportunities to grow our careers and ourselves. We challenge each other to stretch beyond our past to build our future. You are the builder here. You will be part of a team of really smart, motivated, and diverse people and given the autonomy and support to do your best work. It is a dynamic and flexible workplace where you'll belong and be encouraged. If you want to build large\-scale distributed infrastructure for the cloud, this is your team! Oracle is aggressively investing in the Oracle Cloud to provide the industry's broadest, most comprehensive cloud. Only Oracle offers a complete suite of integrated services that include applications as a service, platform as a service, and infrastructure as a service eliminating the data and business process fragmentation that come with cloud silos. A critical part of these silos is the Infrastructure Services, including Compute, Storage, and Messaging service. This is your chance to be part of this exciting Compute team that offers elastic compute capabilities to run any workload in the cloud!!! As a Senior Member of Technical Staff, you will own the software design and development for major components of Oracle's Cloud Infrastructure. You should be both a rock\-solid coder and a distributed systems generalist, able to dive deep into any part of the stack and low\-level systems and design broad distributed system interactions. You should value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn. **Minimum Qualifications** : * 4\+ years of software development experience with distributed systems within large\-scale environments. * Proficient in Java, C, or C\+\+ and experience with scripting languages like Python, Perl, etc. * Experience working on large\-scale, highly distributed services infrastructure. * Experience working in an operational environment with mission\-critical tier\-one livesite servicing. * Systematic problem\-solving approach, strong communication skills, a sense of ownership, and drive. * Experience designing architectures that demonstrate deep technical depth in one area, or span many products, to enable high availability, scalability, market\-leading features and flexibility to meet future business demands. Able to effectively communicate technical ideas verbally and in writing (technical proposals, design specs, architecture diagrams and presentations). * **Preferred Qualifications** : * Demonstrable knowledge of data structures, algorithms, operating systems, distributed systems fundamentals, and cloud\-native development. * Working familiarity with operating systems internals, networking protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP) and standard network architectures. * Strong troubleshooting and performance tuning skills. * Experience building multi\-tenant, virtualized infrastructure, a strong plus.
