jobs.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. We are seeking a Staff Site Reliability Engineer to join our newly formed Operations and Enablement organization, reporting to the Sr Manager of Operations and Enablement team. This role will contribute to the reliability, observability, and operational excellence of our platform infrastructure serving millions of users. As a Staff SRE, you will be a strong technical contributor who implements best practices, solves complex problems, and enables our 200\+ engineers to deliver exceptional customer experiences across our web and native application surfaces. You will work on critical platform systems including EKS infrastructure, Skyway (CI/CD), Frontdoor (Tyk API Gateway), Pantheon (Apollo GraphQL Federation), and our observability stack What You’ll Do: Platform Reliability \& Infrastructure* Implement and maintain highly available AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Fargate (ECS), and multi\-region architectures * Support reliability of critical services: Skyway (CI/CD), Frontdoor (Tyk), Pantheon (Apollo GraphQL), and supporting infrastructure * Monitor SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for Tier 1/2/3 systems; participate in architectural reviews for reliability and cost\-efficiency * Implement reliability patterns including circuit breakers, graceful degradation, and automated failover Observability \& Cost Optimization* Implement observability solutions using NewRelic for APM, distributed tracing, metrics, and logging for rapid troubleshooting * Build dashboards and alerts that reduce MTTD and MTTR; contribute to observability standards across teams * Identify infrastructure cost optimization opportunities and implement FinOps practices including rightsizing and resource lifecycle management * Support cost\-conscious architecture decisions and CI/CD spend optimization (CircleCI, Argo CD) * Build IaC templates for reusability Chaos Engineering \& Incident Response* Execute chaos engineering experiments to identify system weaknesses; contribute to frameworks for safe production testing * Participate in game day exercises and disaster recovery simulations; create runbooks and automation for resilience * Participate in on\-call rotation for critical systems; conduct post\-incident reviews and implement improvements Technical Contribution* Contribute as a strong technical individual contributor to the Observability Enablement team * Collaborate with Platform Engineering, Quality Engineering, and product teams on reliability initiatives * Contribute to Developer Experience metrics and platform adoption goals * Provide technical guidance to junior team members What You'll Bring: * 8\+ years in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering with demonstrated success improving system reliability * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience * 5\+ years hands\-on experience with AWS (EKS, EC2, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, IAM) and Kubernetes including cluster management * Proficient programming skills (Python, Go, or Java) with infrastructure automation and Infrastructure as Code experience (Terraform, CloudFormation) * Production experience with observability tools (NewRelic, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk) and distributed systems * Experience with CI/CD platforms and GitOps workflows (CircleCI, Argo CD, Jenkins); on\-call rotation and incident response * Preferred: Exposure to chaos engineering tools, API Gateway technologies (Tyk/Kong), GraphQL federation (Apollo), cost optimization initiatives, FinOps principles * Technical Skills * Cloud \& Infrastructure: AWS (EKS, Fargate, Lambda, VPC, Route53, CloudFront), Kubernetes, Docker, Istio Service Mesh * CI/CD \& GitOps: Argo CD, CircleCI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions * Observability: NewRelic \- APM, distributed tracing, metrics \& logging; Splunk \- logging * IaC \& Automation: Terraform, CloudFormation, Helm, Kustomize, Python/Go/Bash * Platform Services: Tyk Gateway, Apollo GraphQL, AWS Secrets Manager, Vault * Incident Management: OpsGenie, PagerDuty, ServiceNow * Professional Qualities * Strong communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences * Collaborative approach working across engineering, product, and business teams * Self\-motivated with ability to solve complex problems within established practices and policies * Data\-driven decision making with customer\-centric approach and empathy for developer experience **How We Work:** We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in\-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in\-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together. **How We Reward You:** Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to: * Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage * Family forming benefits * 13 Paid Holidays * Flexible Time Off * 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off * Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3\.5% company match * Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non\-degreed programs * 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions * Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program * Free snacks and refreshments in each office location Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com® Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading\-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we’ll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow. Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Realtor.com® will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals.

jobs.title: Builder - Product Designer
jobs.description: ### **About us:** At Reevo, we're reimagining the entire revenue stack from the ground up, and we're doing it with speed. We're building software that orchestrates every go\-to\-market motion, enabling B2B teams to operate faster, smarter, and more collaboratively. By combining automation, intelligence, and a radically intuitive interface, we're helping companies unlock new levels of productivity and growth across marketing, sales, ops, and customer success teams. If you're excited about working on a product that reshapes how revenue teams work and being surrounded by curious, driven teammates, you'll feel right at home here. From day one, you'll get real ownership, real mentorship, and real impact. Our team of 100\+ builders has over 30 exits under their belt, so you'll be in good company, and working alongside the best! ### **The Role:** We're looking for a product designer at the start of their career — someone who is already building with AI, and who wants to learn the craft in a room full of people doing the work. You'll own pieces of the product, ship them, and see customers use what you made within weeks. You'll do it with a lot of support: you'll work from our San Francisco or Santa Clara office next to senior designers and the engineers and product managers you build with, and the structure, feedback, and mentorship come from being in the room with them every day. We think the job is changing faster than most curricula have caught up with, and that's an advantage for you. Our designers prototype in code, command agents, and ship their own front\-end work. If you've been building things with AI tools because you wanted to, not because a class told you to, you're the kind of person we're looking for. ### **What You Will Do:** **Own real work:** Take well\-scoped design problems end to end — flows, states, edge cases, the details — and deliver them on time, with a lead or a senior designer close by. **Build, don't just mock:** Prototype in code, use agents to get to something clickable fast, and put half\-baked ideas in front of people early. Prototyping something rough to react to is a feature, not a bug. **Learn the customer:** Sit in on sales calls and customer recordings, learn how SDRs, AEs, sales managers, and RevOps leaders actually work, and let that — not taste alone — drive your decisions. **Use the system, and improve it:** Build on our design system rather than around it. When it doesn't have what you need, say so, and help make the case for what should exist. **Ask, share, and get better fast:** Bring work to crit early and often. Share the tools and techniques you're finding — on this team, the newest person is frequently the one who discovers the next workflow everyone adopts. **Show your thinking:** Explain what you made and why. You won't always be right; we care that you can be clear about the call you made and change it when the evidence says to. ### **What We’re Looking For:** * 0–2 years of professional product design experience, including new grads. Internships, freelance work, and things you built on your own all count. * A portfolio of real design work, and real things you've built. Let the work speak for itself — we're not looking for long write\-ups or process explanations. * You're already using AI tools in your daily practice and you're building things with them. This is the closest thing we have to a hard requirement at this level. * Strong instincts for craft and a visible interest in getting better at it, fast. * Curiosity and a technical bent. You're not afraid of a codebase, a terminal, or a tool you've never used. * High agency. You ask for what you need, raise problems early, and don't wait to be assigned. * Based in the Bay Area and in office five days a week — at either our San Francisco or our Santa Clara office, with one day a week in Santa Clara. * No B2B or sales software experience required. We'll teach you the domain. ### **What we offer:** * **Compensation:** A highly competitive base salary and bonus structure, and early\-stage equity that aligns your success directly with the company's growth. * **Comprehensive benefits**: health, dental, and vision coverage, generous paid time off (PTO), plus additional benefits that support how you work. * **Growth and development**: Career advancement paths, dedicated mentorship opportunities, and a strong commitment to investing in your continuous professional development and skill enhancement. * **Dynamic culture**: Join a collaborative, innovative, and fast\-paced work environment where your direct contributions have a tangible and immediate impact on the product, the sales strategy, and the overall company trajectory. Here at Reevo, we know the best ideas come from people with different experiences and perspectives. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic, and we’re happy to provide accommodations throughout the application process.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Build resilient systems. Strengthen security. Connect global operations. Serve as the senior technical resource for RefrigiWear's IT infrastructure, designing and protecting the systems, networks, and integrations that support our business across North America and Europe. The Opportunity RefrigiWear is seeking an experienced Systems Engineer to design, build, secure, and maintain the technology foundation our global operations depend on. This is a senior, hands\-on technical role: you will guide infrastructure and security decisions, lead incident and recovery efforts, deliver complex integrations and automation, and serve as the escalation point for the IT support team. Working closely with the IT Operations Manager, you will balance long\-term technical direction and project delivery with the operational support needed to keep systems reliable, secure, and responsive. What You'll Own * Enterprise integrations \- Design, build, and support integrations among ERP, warehouse management, EDI, e\-commerce, HR, and Microsoft 365 systems, including automated employee onboarding and offboarding. * Infrastructure engineering \- Administer and maintain servers, virtualization, storage, and Microsoft Azure services. * Network operations \- Administer routing, switching, wireless, and firewall infrastructure and resolve complex connectivity issues. * Security operations \- Implement controls aligned with frameworks such as NIST CSF and ISO 27001\. * Incident leadership \- Manage vulnerability remediation, security monitoring, and alert response, and serve as the technical lead during security incidents. * Business continuity \- Maintain backup, replication, and disaster recovery systems and regularly test restores and failover capabilities. How You'll Make an Impact * Develop scripts and automations that reduce manual work and improve system reliability. * Administer user access controls and support periodic access reviews. * Evaluate and apply new tools, including AI\-based solutions, to improve efficiency. * Support system upgrades, migrations, and consolidation projects. * Serve as the escalation point for complex systems, network, application, and security issues. * Document solutions to recurring issues and communicate technical information clearly to non\-technical audiences. * Collaborate effectively with colleagues and vendors across multiple time zones. What Success Looks Like * Core infrastructure remains secure, reliable, scalable, and well documented. * Business systems exchange data accurately through stable, supportable integrations. * Security risks, vulnerabilities, and alerts are addressed with clear ownership and urgency. * Backup and disaster recovery capabilities are routinely tested and ready when needed. * Automation and thoughtful tooling reduce repetitive work and improve operational efficiency. * Complex issues are resolved with both immediate needs and the broader technical environment in view. What You Bring * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * At least seven years of experience in systems engineering, systems administration, or a similar technical role. * Experience designing and supporting integrations between business systems. * Proficiency in scripting or programming with PowerShell, Python, or SQL. * Hands\-on network administration experience, including routing, switching, and firewalls. * Required information security experience; CISSP or a similar certification is a plus. * Experience with disaster recovery and business continuity practices. * Experience with Microsoft 365, Azure, Odoo, or NetSuite is a plus. * Strong troubleshooting, prioritization, communication, and time\-management skills. * A security\-focused approach and the judgment to address tactical issues without losing sight of the larger environment. Work Environment This position operates primarily in an office environment with regular visits to warehouse and equipment\-room areas. Occasional international travel and after\-hours work may be required for scheduled maintenance and system incidents. Why RefrigiWear RefrigiWear is the industry's leading manufacturer of insulated industrial workwear, accessories, and personal protective equipment for subzero temperatures, inclement weather, and low\-visibility environments. This role provides the opportunity to shape the secure technology foundation behind a growing, international business. * Own meaningful infrastructure, security, integration, and recovery initiatives. * Influence technical direction while remaining close to hands\-on engineering work. * Support teams and business systems across North America and Europe. * Evaluate emerging tools and automation opportunities that improve how the organization operates. READY TO ENGINEER WHAT COMES NEXT? Bring your infrastructure expertise, security mindset, and systems perspective to RefrigiWear. RefrigiWear provides equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer - AI Surfaces
jobs.description: ***Posting Type*** Hybrid/Remote ***Job Overview*** WHO WE ARE Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI\-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high\-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial. The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work. WHAT WE DO Gavel is a Microsoft Word\-native agentic surface where lawyers perform real\-time, evidence\-based document editing and drafting. Gavel operates as a small, founder\-led team within Relativity, connecting its product and engineering work with Relativity teams responsible for shared platform capabilities, identity, and security. ***Job Description and Requirements*** ABOUT THE ROLE As a Lead Software Engineer, you will be the full\-stack technical owner for a major area of Gavel’s product, such as a family of agents or a core capability including the context pipeline, evaluation platform, or Word integration. You will own the technical plan across the front end, harness, and data layer, along with the quality of releases and the growth of the two to four engineers building the area with you. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. Roughly half of your time will be spent coding. You will work directly with Gavel’s CTO and Staff Engineer on architecture and represent your area to the broader Relativity technology team when it intersects with shared platform, identity, or security. The role reports to Pierre Martin, CTO of Gavel and VP of Engineering at Relativity, and may be based remotely in the United States or in Seattle or Chicago. WHAT YOU’LL DO * Own the technical roadmap and delivery for your area, from design through production monitoring. Break ambiguous product goals into shippable milestones and sequence them across the stack. * Design and build agents and the infrastructure they run on, including tool definitions, prompts and context assembly, structured outputs, guardrails, evaluation sets, and the Word and web experiences that surface them. * Run the evaluation and release loop for your agents. Understand acceptance rates, identify why results change, and determine whether a change is ready to ship. * Model a modern software development lifecycle for your squad through small, frequent commits, feature\-flagged production deployments, fast rollbacks, and daily use of agentic engineering tools to improve quality and velocity. * Partner directly with Dorna Moini, Pierre Martin, product, and design on what to build next, and engage with customers when the answer is not clear from the data. * Lead design reviews, establish coding and testing standards for your squad, mentor Senior and Advanced engineers, and participate in hiring. * Work with Relativity platform and security teams on areas that touch shared infrastructure, identity, or compliance. jobs.description: PLEASE NOTE: This role is Hybrid \- Remote with occasional travel to the come in East Dallas. A few days per year.. This role will report directly to the CTO with direct interaction of the Founder / CEO. There is no work sponsorship or relocation assistance offered for this role. We are seeking a highly motivated and innovative Senior Software Engineer to join our dynamic team, focusing on developing and enhancing our cutting\-edge Medical Billing Automation SaaS platform. This role offers an exciting opportunity to leverage advanced technologies such as Python, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Large Language Models (LLMs), and Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) to revolutionize healthcare billing processes. As a key contributor, you will drive the design, development, and deployment of scalable, reliable solutions that streamline medical billing workflows, improve accuracy, and enhance user experience. Join us in transforming healthcare technology with your expertise and passion for software engineering! **Duties** * Lead the development of backend systems using Python, ensuring robust integration with AI models, LLMs, and EDI protocols to automate complex billing tasks. * Design and implement scalable microservices architectures utilizing cloud infrastructure such as AWS or Azure to support high\-volume data processing. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to develop RESTful APIs and web services that facilitate seamless communication between components and external systems. * Develop intuitive front\-end interfaces with React, Angular, or similar frameworks to improve usability for end\-users managing billing workflows. * Apply system design principles to create efficient database schemas using relational databases like SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL, as well as NoSQL options like MongoDB. * Implement rigorous testing strategies including unit testing, integration testing, and debugging to ensure high\-quality deliverables aligned with SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) standards. * Participate actively in Agile software development practices such as Scrum or Kanban, contributing to sprint planning, stand\-ups, and continuous improvement initiatives. **Skills** * Extensive experience with Python programming language for backend development and AI integration. * Strong knowledge of AI technologies including Large Language Models (LLMs) and their application in automation solutions. * Proficiency in EDI standards and protocols essential for healthcare data exchange processes. * Technical Skills * **Expert\-level Python for ETL/ELT pipelines and automation, including libraries such as pandas, pydantic, and SQLAlchemy.** Production experience with a workflow orchestration platform such as Prefect, Airflow, or Dagster. * **Strong SQL fluency across relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake); familiarity with dbt or similar transformation tooling.** Disciplined testing and delivery practices: pytest or equivalent, continuous integration (GitHub Actions or similar), Docker, and Git\-based code review. * **Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and services, Azure preferred.** Effective, verified use of AI\-assisted development tools as part of daily engineering practice Join us to be part of a forward\-thinking team dedicated to transforming healthcare billing through innovative AI automation software solutions! Your expertise will directly impact the efficiency and accuracy of medical billing processes worldwide while advancing your career in a fast\-paced technological environment. Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Fort Worth, TX 76104

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Computer Vision
jobs.description: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description ### **Position Summary:** Rockwell Automation is building FT Analytics VisionAI, a machine vision and visual inspection into the Portfolio. You will be the senior technical authority for the vision models behind that capability \- the detection, classification, and anomaly models that decide whether a part passes or fails on a line running at production rate, on hardware sitting next to a Logix controller. This is a hands\-on role. You will set the modeling direction, own the evaluation methodology that says whether a model is good enough to ship, and work directly with manufacturing customers on what their defects actually look like. Accuracy targets here are set by a customer's scrap rate and cycle time, not by a benchmark leaderboard. You will build in an AI\-first engineering environment \- coding agents running inside a harness we own, evals gating AI\-generated changes, GitHub Copilot Enterprise and Claude in the daily loop, and MCP\-based tooling that lets agents reach real build, test, and telemetry systems under human\-in\-the\-loop review. You will also help define what eval\-driven development means for model code specifically, where the regression suite gates a model release the way a test suite gates a build. external forums, technical presentations, and other knowledge\-sharing opportunities. * Perform other duties as required. **Qualifications:** * 8\-12 years of progressive experience in data engineering, with extensive experience leading the architecture and implementation of large\-scale, cloud\-native data solutions. * Expert\-level proficiency with Databricks, including Delta Live jobs.title: Engineer II
jobs.description: Whether you're a recent grad or a seasoned professional, you can experience meaningful career growth at Rosendin. Engaged.** If you're looking to take your career to the next level and work with some of the best and brightest in the industry, we want to hear from you. Since our founding over 100\+ years ago, Rosendin has been driven to positively impact the communities where we live and work. We are an organization built on integrity and we have a culture that empowers people, embraces diversity, and inspires everyone to do their best. As one of the largest EMPLOYEE\-OWNED electrical contractors in the United States, you will have the unique benefit of being a shareholder at a company that is experiencing tremendous growth and success. When our people succeed and fuel our success, we reward them. We'd love to have you as a shareholder! **YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY:** -------------------------- The Engineer II is a mid\-level engineering position responsible for providing technical engineering information and support to the senior engineers to ensure that projects comply with the project requirements and all engineering standards, applicable codes, and specifications. Knowledge of various electrical engineering concepts, including power distribution, lighting, grounding, energy conservation, and value engineering related to designing state\-of\-the\-art, constructible projects. **WHAT YOU'LL DO:** ------------------- * Oversee junior engineers, designers, and staff assigned to your work or team. In this instance, an Engineer II would feel comfortable and capable of leading projects of limited scope. * Review, comment, and process equipment and system submittals in coordination with the Engineer of Record. * Generate electrical specifications appropriate for the project. * Develop a complete and accurate sequence of operations for all designed systems. * Working knowledge of equipment and system testing and commissioning. * Perform process coordination between architectural, structural, mechanical, plumbing, and all electrical trades. * Prepare designs, check, and specify power, lighting, and auxiliary systems. * Prepare power system single\-line diagrams, including feeder, over current protection sizing, and equipment elevations. * Conduct short circuit, over current protection device coordination studies, and Arc Flash mitigation Studies. * Perform calculations to determine distribution capacity due to voltage drop, voltage droop, or underground heat effect (Neher\-McGrath). * Coordinate your work with the project Specifications or equipment buy\-out. * Visit job sites to field survey existing electrical conditions. * May include on\-site field assignments * Utilize engineering analysis programs and professional judgment to analyze loads, lighting levels, and short circuit currents. * Conduct value engineering functions. * Attend project design team meetings. Interface with various team members, particularly the client, architect, and mechanical contractor/engineer. * Research and resolve drawing interpretation problems, conflicts, interferences, and errors. * Represent the design group during the construction to ensure the operations team is provided with proper and timely information for installation. This will include attendance at Owner and Contractor meetings. * The duties and responsibilities describe this position's general nature and scope of work. This is a partial listing, and other responsibilities will be assigned based on the position's role within the business unit. **WHAT YOU BRING TO US:** ------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in engineering, architectural engineering, construction sciences, or equivalent experience. * Typically requires a minimum of 2 years of Engineering Experience * This candidate may have completed the Engineer\-In\-Training and is encouraged to pursue registration as a Professional Engineer. * LEED AP® is desired for this position. * Can be a combination of education, training, and relevant experience **COMPETENCIES:** ----------------- * Teamwork * Productivity * Strategic thinking **WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL:** -------------------------------------- * Requires working electrical engineering knowledge, including power distribution, lighting, grounding, energy conservation, and value engineering related to designing state\-of\-the\-art constructible projects. * Fully competent in the majority of Engineer I skills. * High\-rise residential, Commercial, and Data Center experience is a plus. * Proficiency in Analytics programs for short circuit and over\-current coordination and arc flash analysis programs. * Fluency with the Codes. * Working knowledge of the energy efficiency requirements. * Proficient in Autodesk, Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, etc.); illumination software * Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks, changing priorities as necessary * Ability to work to meet deadlines and adapt to changing requirements with a positive attitude * Effective oral and written communication skills as required for the position * Ability to be self\-motivated, proactive, and an effective team player * Ability to interact effectively and professionally with all levels of employees, both management and staff alike, vendors, clients, and others **TRAVEL:** ----------- * Up to 25% (Does not include local field visits) **WORKING CONDITIONS:** ----------------------- * General work environment \- sitting for long periods, standing, walking, typing, carrying, pushing, bending. Work is conducted primarily indoors with varying environmental conditions, such as fluorescent lighting and air conditioning * Noise level is usually low to medium * Occasional lifting of up to 40 lbs. * We fully comply with the ADA and applicable state law, including considering reasonable accommodation measures that may enable qualified disabled applicants and employees to perform essential functions. Rosendin Electric is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are considered regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, age (over 40\), or any other categories protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. **YOU Matter \- Our Benefits** ------------------------------ * ESOP \- Employee Stock Ownership * 401K * Annual bonus program based upon performance, profitability, and achievement * 17 PTO days per year plus 10 paid holidays * Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance * Term Life, AD\&D Insurance, and Voluntary Life Insurance * Disability Income Protection Insurance * Pre\-tax Flexible Spending Plans (Health and Dependent Care) * Charitable Giving Match with our Rosendin Foundation Our success is rooted in our people. We all come together around long\-term vision and a sense of shared ownership. As a group, we do whatever it takes to ensure the success of our business and your career. Rosendin Electric is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are considered regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status. **Pay Transparency Requirements:** $93,900\.00\-$123,200\.00 Annual

The HV Project Engineer should have knowledge of most aspects of MV/HV electrical engineering \- as an example, while not conducting the work, the individual should be able to review and comment on any of the below with minimal support from other engineering staff: * HV Transmission and Substation SLD/Layouts * Ampacity, short circuit, and protection coordination studies * Technical studies such as harmonics, transients, Ampacity, Short Circuit, Load Flow, Grounding, and any other study to the HV and MV field The ability to assume responsibility, interface, and coordinate with others is required as portions of the engineering effort will be subcontracted out which is managed by the HV Engineering PM. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES \- HV SUBSTATION AND TRANSMISSION SYSTEMS:** * Select, scope, and oversee subcontractors or internal engineering resources assigned to your work or project. In this instance, the individual must be comfortable and capable to supervise a design group of 1\-4 subcontractors for a single project. * Assist in reviewing contracts for potential pitfalls or highlight obligations of REI to the client * Assist REI Project Management in selection of equipment and securing of long lead items. * Assist or perform preliminary designs for prospective projects that REI is pursuing. This would require being capable of developing a SLD and GA from scratch for estimating purposes. * Review, comment, and oversee a HV design performed by others as well as equipment procured by REI. Knowledge of how to specify the relative BIL, voltage withstands, S/C electrical and mechanical ratings is required to perform the reviews. * Develop and communicate conceptual SLD, Layout, transmission lines with little to no support. machine‑learning‑based algorithms for detection, inspection, automation, classification, tracking, and prediction using SICK 2D/3D cameras and programmable devices. * Employ advanced techniques—such jobs.description: **Who we are** Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. **About the role:** The Sr. Regional Web Product Manager owns the strategy, roadmap, and performance of Samsara's regional websites across MX, CAN, and EMEA markets, with new locales as we expand. The role aligns each regional site to how buyers in that market research, evaluate, and buy. You will define those experiences, build the roadmap to get there, and prove the impact through experimentation and measurement. This is a cross\-functional individual contributor role. You will partner with regional teams and with Brand, Content, Product Marketing, Growth, and Web Engineering to shape the experience, and you will set the operating model other teams adopt when they publish internationally. If you want to own a business\-critical surface end to end and shape how a global company shows up in every market it sells in, this role is for you. **In this role, you will:** * Own the strategy and roadmap for Samsara's regional websites — defining what we build, in what order, and why, and holding the roadmap accountable to regional pipeline and awareness goals * Define how success is measured for regional web — Set the metrics, targets, and reporting that regional and marketing leadership use to evaluate the channel * Work with cross\-functional pods of designers, engineers, content strategists, and regional marketers — setting direction, sequencing the work, and unblocking delivery * Build and run the experimentation program for regional sites — CRO, testing, and personalization strategy * Partner with content marketing teams to drive successful AEO and SEO strategies, and stay current on best practices and latest innovations * Identify AI use cases and deploy agents to improve all stages of regional site product management and development * Lead a high\-complexity regional web initiatives, new market launches, site architecture changes, regional redesigns, from concept through launch and post\-launch measurement * Communicate regional web performance and roadmap progress to marketing leadership and regional stakeholders on a regular cadence, translating results into recommendations rather than status updates * Raise the capability of the wider web and regional marketing teams — mentoring ICs, creating shared learning and documentation, and serving as the go\-to expert on international web * Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices **Minimum requirements for the role:** * 5\+ years in web product management, digital experience, or web strategy, including direct ownership of the roadmap for a high\-traffic marketing site * Experience owning web experiences in multiple international markets, including localizing those experiences for in\-market relevance rather than translating a single source site * Track record of running a web experimentation program, including setting the standards and interpreting the results * Working knowledge of web analytics and experimentation tools (e.g. Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Tableau, and an A/B testing platform), and the ability to build measurement structures rather than request them * Technical SEO and AEO foundation, including international considerations * Experience working directly with engineering on a modern web stack: CMS architecture, component systems, performance, and release process * Executive communication skills, including making the case for a regional web strategy to marketing leadership and to regional stakeholders with competing priorities * Track record of driving outcomes through influence across functions and geographies without formal authority * Has built AI workflows or agents into their own way of working, and pushes the team's thinking on what comes next \#LI\-Remote **Total Rewards** At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. **Flexible Working** At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. jobs.title: Senior Firmware Engineer I
jobs.description: Job Description: *Do you want to join the world’s most sustainable company\* as one of our new Firmware Engineers, working in a team of experts with state\-of\-the\-art technologies?* *We are seeking more highly talented and self\-motivated Senior Firmware Engineer to join in our global R\&D.* *You will be responsible for creating firmware for an efficient, maintainable and coherent product architecture.* **Make a difference \- join Schneider Electric** Schneider’s purpose is to empower all to make the most of our energy and resources, bridging progress and sustainability for all. At Schneider, we call this Life Is On. We help our customers make the most of their energy by being the best at what we do. We are a global frontrunner in green energy solutions, we operate in industry, energy infrastructure, data centers, industrial construction as well as housing with a broad supply of solutions and products to energy optimization. We are a global company with a strong local presence. We are more than 160,000 employees in 100\+ countries creating an annual turnover of EUR 38 billion. **Talent with an innovative mindset** We are looking for talent at all levels with motivation to embark on an exciting journey within the field of 3\-phased UPS systems and related secure power technologies. Your starting point will be continuous development of recently released products as a part of the R\&D organization, and with the long\-term plan to transition towards innovation. You will join the Firmware team consisting of highly skilled engineers and you will collaborate closely with colleagues with different specialist backgrounds operating on various technologies such as microprocessors, soft cores, FPGA and SoC in an agile environment. You can relate to our innovation culture and deployment within R\&D: *learn fast, fail fast, monetize fast*. Relationship building is close to your heart as well as developing internal and external partnerships. **Your key responsibilities** * Full lifecycle involvement in design, implementation, and validation of embedded C/C\+\+ firmware for UPS Systems, Power Electronics and related secure power technologies * Adopt in\-house best practice for code integrity and design validation * Ensure that the integrity of the system and firmware architecture is maintained throughout the lifecycle of the product * Cross functional collaboration to ensure the timely delivery of high\-quality firmware releases (External) English Qualifications: **You need the following qualifications and experience for this role** * Proficiency in C/C\+\+ for embedded systems * Knowledge of digital control systems * Experience or knowledge in communication protocols, signal processing, and/or tool chains * Experience with embedded Linux, GIT, VHDL, Python, or FPGA is advantageous * Previous involvement in the development of innovative and groundbreaking digital products is also advantageous **EDUCATION** * Bachelor’s (Master’s a plus) degree in computer science, electrical/electronic engineering, or equivalent **SKILLS** * Excellent communication, interpersonal and collaboration * Capability to grow in a multicultural environment is key * Proficiency in English * Structured and organized way of work **EXPERIENCE** * Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience * Experience from domain of power conversion is a plus **TRAVEL** * Position doesn’t include frequent travel **Many career opportunities and focus on development** At Schneider Electric we want the best employees. To help you grow and develop, we provide training across multiple topics, personal development or the latest technology. You will meet a work environment focused on work\-life balance, collaboration and creativity. You will meet great colleagues, a modern working environment, and flexible working hours. We offer you opportunities to widen your expertise and international professional network. We have great and continuous learning opportunities. Our employees are empowered to develop to their fullest potential, through equal opportunities for ongoing development. **New Ways of Working** We are flexible and adaptable in our work. This applies both in terms of time and place and in our utilization of technology and solutions that support our work. Together with you, we ensure that we have a state\-of\-the\-art workplace, with the opportunity to achieve our ambitious commercial goals, the possibility to take care of each other, and the framework to maintain our well\-being and a good and balanced working life. **Are you interested?** Then submit your online application, your resume and diplomas as soon as possible. jobs.title: Research Programmer III- Machine Learning & Computational Neuroscience, Kennedy Lab
jobs.description: **POSITION TITLE:**Research Programmer III (Software Engineer) **POSITION SUMMARY:** The Kennedy laboratory is involved in numerous projects to track, quantify, and forecast individual and group behavior and relate it to recorded neural activity. We develop new computational methods to understand how agents (animals, humans, virtual) gather information about their sensory environment, integrate this with internal motivational needs, and execute goal\-directed actions in complex, naturalistic environments. We also develop machine learning and computer vision platforms for high\-throughput animal phenotyping, with the goal of accelerating drug screening and repurposing efforts at Scripps. We seek motivated individuals interested in gaining hands\-on experience in scientific research projects, with a goal of contributing to scientific papers and participating in an active lab environment. You will also have the opportunity to lead independent research projects on existing datasets from our collaborators (U Penn, UCLA, Harvard, U Utah, Northwestern, and others). This is an ideal position for applicants interested in building their scientific CV ahead of applying to graduate programs in Computational Neuroscience or Machine Learning, or those looking for a longer term position where they can contribute to original scientific research and model development. **REQUIREMENTS:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Math, or related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training and/or experience. Other STEM degrees may be accepted if accompanied with programming education, training, and/or experience. * Minimum of four years experience in software application development or research programming. * Experience with software development in Python. * Experience building and training deep neural networks for supervised, unsupervised, or reinforcement learning problems. * A demonstrated ability to apply the fundamentals of software application development. * Experience with version control, including git and github. **Please include code samples and/or a link to a public code repository with examples of your work.** **PREFERRED SKILLSET:** Prior experience with the one or more of the following is preferred: * Experience with sequence/time series data, control/reinforcement learning problems and environments, time series forecasting. * An understanding of generative modeling (hidden Markov models, diffusion models, etc). * Familiarity with topics in motor control, robotics, and neuroscience. As a member of a computational lab working in team projects, the following general skills are also preferred: * Experience developing scalable system architectures that adhere to good software engineering principles. * Ability to tackle large, open\-ended research questions independently and as part of a team. * Willingness to be an active participant in a computational lab environment, including taking part in lab meetings, journal clubs, and hackathons. * Experience working within a diverse, interdisciplinary team. * Experience contributing to open source software projects. **LOCATION:** La Jolla, California. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS****:** This position works in an office environment, and it is expected that work will be primarily performed in\-person. **COMPENSTAION:** The expected hiring range for this position is $75,000 to $100,000 per year, commensurate with experience. **COMPREHENSIVE BENEFITS INCLUDE:** * Employer Contributed Retirement Plan – Depending on eligibility, employees receive an employer contributed retirement plan (no employee contribution required) and the option to contribute to a 403(b) (which is similar to a 401(k) using your own pre or post\-tax dollars) * Full Suite of Health and Welfare plans including three medical plan options (including an HSA available option), dental, vision, life insurance, disability, EAP and more * Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (Medical/Dependent Care) * Competitive vacation and sick leave policies * Free, on\-site parking *The above statements describe the level of work performed and expected in general terms. The statements are not intended to list all the responsibilities, duties and/or skills required of employees so classified, and the content herein is subject to change due to the business needs of Scripps Research, with or without notice. Furthermore, nothing in this job description shall be interpreted to be in conflict with or to eliminate or modify in any way the employment\-at\-will status of Scripps Research staff.* **EEO Statement:** The Scripps Research Institute is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Senior Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **About Sempulse** Sempulse makes an FDA\-cleared, non\-invasive vital signs monitor called Halo that streams real\-time patient data to first responders and clinicians. It's validated by the U.S. Military, SOCOM, NATO, the Gates Foundation, and the Cleveland Clinic, among others, and it's been selected for the U.S. Army's Project Convergence. In December 2024, it saved its first life in the field. We're looking for a senior individual\-contributor role to help build the firmware that runs on Halo itself. **About the Work** This is primarily a firmware (software) development role. You'll contribute to the design, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of the low\-level code that runs on Halo, spanning key subsystems like power management, sensor integration, storage, memory management, and user I/O that provide core support for the algorithms and application communication. Engineers comfortable making light modifications to development boards to support prototyping and device updates will have an advantage here, occasionally serving as a supporting cast member to our manufacturing team when those needs come up. Halo is an FDA\-cleared device, which strongly influences our development and testing process. You'll work directly with our quality team to make sure V\&V and the right quality checkpoints are in place for all changes. We require rigorous testing and expect engineers to take responsibility for their work, including careful design, testing, and incorporating peer review from others. **What We're Looking For** * Professional experience building low\-level firmware for battery\-powered, Bluetooth\-connected devices. Medical device experience is ideal but not required. * Genuine depth with the SDK of one of the major SoC providers (e.g., Nordic, Silicon Labs, or STMicroelectronics), ideally across multiple SDK generations, with a credible story for picking up a new platform quickly. * Experience owning board bring\-up, toolchain migration, and porting existing drivers to new platforms, with specific examples you can speak to in detail. * Real, hands\-on driver development experience: you've written drivers against a datasheet, not just called into ones someone else wrote. * A strong sense of software architecture for embedded systems: you make deliberate calls about module boundaries and abstraction layers, and can defend those calls as the firmware grows. * You've written and debugged real production C yourself (not just through an AI agent), and you understand what your code is doing well enough to describe it clearly, in detail, to others. * Experience or strong interest in utilizing Rust in embedded applications. * Confident making light changes to board layout to support prototyping and device updates: reading schematics, bench work, and component\-level reasoning. Ideally you've studied electrical engineering or computer engineering, or have equivalent hands\-on industry experience. * Experience applying test automation at multiple levels: unit, integration, end\-to\-end, and comfort contributing to hardware\-in\-the\-loop automation, not just app\-level testing. * A real sense of ownership over the code you write. Your instinct should be to leave it better than you found it, including code that you didn't write. You know how to refactor with confidence. * Comfortable working within a regulated quality system: documentation, traceability, formal review. The strongest candidates will have hands\-on experience with V\&V and release processes in a regulated environment (medical device or similar). * Low ego, high confidence: you flag problems and propose better approaches without being asked. **How to Apply** Please submit a resume and brief cover letter explaining your experiences and how you're uniquely qualified for this role. **Location and Travel** Our engineering team is fully distributed, and we hire talent from anywhere. Travel is minimal, with occasional trips for in\-person working sessions, software demonstrations, or to support our manufacturing team when necessary. Candidates should expect periodic travel to Central Texas (Austin, San Antonio), California (San Diego), Pennsylvania, or Connecticut. *Note: No offshore resources or hiring agents.* Benefits: * 401(k) * Health insurance * Paid time off Work Location: Remote

proposals. #### **What We're Looking For** ##### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Railway Engineering, Transportation Engineering, or a related discipline. * 10\+ years of railway engineering experience. * Demonstrated experience supporting major High\-Speed Rail projects (300 km/h\+ / 186 mph\+). * Strong experience in railway track design and trackwork systems. * Experience supporting projects through design, construction, testing, and commissioning. * Deep understanding of railway alignment design, track geometry, operational requirements, and rail systems integration. * Strong familiarity with AREMA standards and international rail standards. * Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. * Willingness to relocate to or equivalent accreditation. * Experience in Design\-Build, EPC, or large\-scale railway infrastructure programs. * Experience with ballast track, slab track, depots, yards, switches, turnouts, and special trackwork. * Experience using railway design, alignment, BIM, and CAD tools. ##### **Industry Experience We Value** * High\-Speed Rail (HSR) * Intercity Passenger Rail * Commuter Rail * Metro \& Light Rail Transit (LRT) * Freight Rail Infrastructure * Rail Design\-Build Projects * Railway EPC Projects ##### **What We Offer** At Sener, you will find more than a job. jobs.description: Washington Navy Yard, District of Columbia, US, 20374 Category: Navy Job ID: 34503 widget: Full\-Time Secret No \- Teleworking not available for this position $119574\.56\-$199290\.94 ### **Position Description \& Qualifications** If you seek a rewarding, high profile and challenging position supporting projects for the US Navy, Serco has a wonderful opportunity for you! jobs.title: Repair Operations & Quality Manager
jobs.description: **Socomec Group** (Socomec) is a global leader in electrical equipment engineering and manufacturing, specialized in low voltage energy performance. **Socomec North America** (NAM) is Socomec’s organization overseeing all operations in North America. **About This Role** The Repair and Quality Center Manager leads the North American Repair and Quality Center within the Expert Services organization. The role owns the return lifecycle from receipt through technical evaluation and final disposition, including repair, refurbishment, root cause analysis, return material authorization coordination, and controlled scrap. The manager ensures accurate documentation, traceability, and reporting of return status, test results, technical findings, disposition decisions, and corrective\-action progress. The manager develops the center as the primary North American resolution point for returned equipment and repairable components. The role converts return, repair, and parts\-usage data into actionable analysis; identifies recurring or epidemic failure patterns; and coordinates evidence\-based escalation with business\-line quality leaders, engineering, vendors, overseas factories, and service leadership. This includes reviewing and driving vendor and factory RCA and 8D responses through corrective\-action closure. Business\-line quality leaders retain product\-quality governance; this role provides the return intelligence and case management needed for timely decisions. Safety and Operational Philosophy The center handles electrical and electronic assemblies that may contain stored energy, damaged components, unknown failure conditions, or incomplete field information. The manager is accountable for appropriate lockout and tagout, electrical safe\-work practices, electrostatic\-discharge controls, test\-bench safeguards, material handling, and approved repair procedures. Production pressure, customer urgency, turnaround commitments, or cost considerations do not justify bypassing safety controls, unsupported repair decisions, or untraceable disposition. The manager must protect people and evidence, maintain configuration and material traceability, and stop, quarantine, or escalate work that exceeds approved capability or authorization. **Key Responsibilities And Accountabilities** * Leads the safe, compliant, and effective operation of the North American Repair and Quality Center, including personnel, workload, work areas, test equipment, repair processes, material controls, and daily operating priorities. * Owns the complete lifecycle of customer and technician returns from receipt through technical evaluation and documented disposition, including return for repair, refurbishment, root cause analysis, supplier or factory review, return to stock, or controlled scrap. * Develops repair capability for approved repairable components by establishing test methods, acceptance criteria, work instructions, spare\-parts support, technician authorization, and quality controls that produce safe and repeatable repairs. * Builds the center to resolve at least 80 percent of eligible return cases within North America before factory or engineering escalation, while maintaining defined escalation criteria and complete technical evidence for cases requiring higher\-level support. * Manages customer and field\-service return material authorizations across business lines, ensuring clear case ownership, accurate status communication, timely disposition, and coordination of operational priorities with Service, Logistics, Sales, and business\-line stakeholders. * Analyzes parts usage, failure modes, repair findings, no\-fault\-found returns, repeat failures, and return trends to identify emerging or epidemic issues and provide business\-line quality leaders with actionable evidence and recommended containment or corrective actions. * Leads or coordinates structured root cause analysis for returned products and components, determines when factory or engineering involvement is required, and ensures escalation packages include failure history, test results, configuration data, photographs, parts information, and other relevant evidence. * Recruits, develops, and leads repair and return personnel while establishing performance measures, capacity plans, documentation standards, cross\-training, and continuous\-improvement priorities that allow the center to scale with the North American installed base. **Essential Qualifications, Experience, And Skills** * Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering required. * Typically 7 or more years of progressive experience in quality engineering, electrical or power\-electronics engineering, product support, repair operations, reliability, manufacturing quality, or mission\-critical technical service. * Demonstrated quality\-engineering experience with returned\-product analysis, nonconformance management, corrective action, root cause analysis, failure trending, or RMA processes required. * Demonstrated exp nical boundaries. * Strong data\-analysis capability using ERP, quality, service, spreadsheet, and business\-intelligence tools to track failure patterns, turnaround, repair yield, and cost. * Clear technical communication and timely decision\-making under pressure while preserving safety, evidence quality, procedural compliance, and escalation integrity. **Repair and Quality Center Manager Expectations** * This is an onsite leadership role based at the Suwanee, Georgia manufacturing plant. The position operates within Expert Services and works closely with plant functions while supporting North American customers and all business lines. * Work is performed in office, warehouse, manufacturing, electrical test, and component\-repair environments. Required personal protective equipment and electrostatic\-discharge controls must be used as applicable. * The role may provide technical or operational support outside normal business hours when significant customer, safety, quality, or return events require leadership attention. * Travel within North America and occasional international travel may be required for factory coordination, supplier or customer review, training, audits, or capability development; expected travel is generally up to 20 percent. * A valid driver license and the ability to obtain and maintain a valid passport are required. * Successful completion of applicable pre\-employment screening, background checks, and site\-access requirements is required. **Physical Demands** * Mobility: Ability to move throughout office, warehouse, manufacturing, repair, and test environments; work may involve standing, walking, climbing, bending, or kneeling for extended periods. * Stationary Work: Ability to remain seated or standing for prolonged periods while reviewing data, conducting technical evaluations, observing tests, or completing documentation. * Manual Dexterity: Ability to use computers, test equipment, hand tools, and small components when supporting inspection, evaluation, or repair activities. * Lifting and Carrying: Ability to lift, carry, or move items weighing up to 50 pounds on an occasional basis. * Visual and Auditory Requirements: Ability to inspect components, read technical documents and computer screens, observe test activity, and communicate effectively in office and plant environments. * Travel: Ability to travel by vehicle and commercial transportation and to work at factories, supplier locations, customer sites, or other company facilities as required. **Compensation range: $95,000 – $105,000** \#LI\-YZW Upon request, we will provide reasonable accommodation for disabilities to support participation of candidates in all aspects of the recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Fullstack AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Why you should join us** -------------------------- At Solstice, we're building AI software that helps life sciences teams turn complex scientific and brand information into marketing content they can create, refine, and review with confidence. We've worked with leading life sciences manufacturers and more than 50 pharma brands. You'll build the systems and experiences that make this work faster and easier. * **Build the foundation for how people work with AI.** Your work will span the infrastructure that runs agents and the product experiences that help customers direct, inspect, and use their output. * **Take on engineering problems with depth.** Make long\-running agents reliable, stream progress into responsive interfaces, deliver the right context securely, and understand what happens across every step of execution. * **Have a direct hand in what we build.** Join an early team where you'll shape architecture, make product tradeoffs, and work closely with our co\-founders, Yiwen and Aris. You'll see your decisions reach customers and use their feedback to improve the product. We're backed by Transformation Capital, Twelve Below, Virtue, and the founders of Datavant, Commure, and Paradigm. **About the role** ------------------ We're looking for a Fullstack AI Engineer to build and maintain our agent platform and bring its capabilities into the product. You'll own work across backend services, APIs, agent orchestration, and customer\-facing interfaces, with a strong focus on Python and platform engineering. Python is our primary backend language, and FastAPI powers our APIs. You'll help decide how agents run, recover from failures, access tools and context, and communicate with the application. You'll also build the React and Next.js experiences that give users visibility and control over that work. You'll partner with product, design, Applied AI, and the broader engineering team to take problems from an initial idea through architecture, implementation, and production. The scope includes both building new capabilities and making the systems behind them easier to operate and extend. **What you'll be working on** ----------------------------- * **Build and maintain the agent platform.** Use Python, FastAPI, Restate, and Redis to build the shared systems that power our agents. Shape session management, orchestration, tool access, and context delivery so new AI capabilities can build on a dependable foundation. * **Design APIs that power the product.** Build Python and FastAPI services for content creation, document processing, collaboration, and enterprise integrations. Design clear API contracts and PostgreSQL data models that make complex workflows straightforward to build on. * **Solve the hard parts of agent execution.** Make long\-running workflows recover from failures, handle cancellation and retries, and run in isolated environments. Give agents current documents, assets, and brand context while keeping customer data and permissions properly scoped. * **Bring AI workflows to life in the product.** Build with React, Next.js, and TypeScript to show streaming progress and tool activity, support reconnectable sessions, and give users intuitive ways to review, accept, or refine AI output. * **Make the whole system observable.** Connect APIs, orchestration, and agent execution through Datadog and OpenTelemetry tracing, structured logs, metrics, and alerts. Build the visibility to explain failures, find bottlenecks, and improve latency, reliability, and cost. * **Make quality measurable.** Partner with Applied AI engineers on evaluations and regression checks, using tools such as Braintrust alongside API and integration tests. Turn production traces and customer feedback into better agent behavior and more dependable releases. * **Own the path from idea to production.** Work with product and customer teams to choose the right problems, make practical tradeoffs, and ship complete features. Deploy, monitor, and improve what you build as customers use it. **Some ideal traits we're looking for** --------------------------------------- * **Depth in Python and FastAPI.** You've shipped and operated production Python services. You can build well\-designed FastAPI APIs and understand asynchronous programming, validation, authentication, and error handling. * **Strong systems fundamentals.** You design clear service contracts and data models, work comfortably with PostgreSQL and Redis, and think through concurrency, transactions, idempotency, and failure recovery. * **Experience turning AI into useful software.** You've built AI applications or the infrastructure behind them. You can reason about tool calling, context management, agent sessions, and the boundaries between model behavior and application logic. * **The ability to deliver across the stack.** You're comfortable working in React, Next.js, and TypeScript and connecting an interface to backend APIs. You care about how the product feels, including usability, accessibility, and performance. * **A habit of making systems understandable.** You use traces, logs, and metrics to investigate production issues and build instrumentation that helps the next engineer diagnose them. Testing, security, and maintainability are part of how you ship. * **Ownership and good judgment.** You can turn an ambiguous problem into a practical plan, explain the tradeoffs, and follow through. You work closely with others, seek feedback, and care about whether your work solves the customer's problem. Experience with Restate or Temporal, sandboxed agent execution, streaming systems, or AI evaluation tools is a plus. You don't need experience with every tool in our stack. We value strong fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly. Healthcare or pharma experience is welcome but not required. **Benefits** ------------ * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * Equity in an early\-stage company * Unlimited paid time off * 401(k) with a 4% employer match * Company\-provided office lunches five days a week * A stipend for professional development * Relocation assistance * Sponsorship for O\-1, H\-1B, and TN visas **Competitive NYC compensation** -------------------------------- The base salary range for this role is $200,000 to $300,000, plus equity. Compensation reflects your experience, seniority, and the scope of responsibility you take on. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K
